```python
        a = 2*PI*k/8
        b.wedge('tapered-spoke', [(.12,-.055),(.34,-.026),(.35,.026),(.12,.055)], .055,
                (x,face-side*.034,r), 'paint', rot=(0,-a,0), bevel=.009, segments=2)
    b.cyl('wheel-centre', .139, .062, (x,face,r), 'paint', rot=Y_AXIS, verts=32, bevel=.012)
    b.cyl('hub-cap', .080, .08, (x,face+side*.035,r), 'gunmetal', rot=Y_AXIS, verts=24, bevel=.01)
    _nuts(b, 'wheel-nuts', (x,face+side*.042,r), .113, 8, .015)


def mob_c(b, m):
    """Lightweight Running Gear: aggressive shoulder tread and eight open spokes."""
    for x,y,side in _wheels(m):
        _tyre(b,m,x,y)
        _open_rim(b,m,x,y,side)


def _hub(b, at, side, radius=.23):
    x,y,z = at
    b.cyl('reduction-housing', radius, .15, at, 'paint', rot=Y_AXIS, verts=32, bevel=.022)
    _ring(b, 'reduction-flange', radius*1.07, .024, .027, (x,y+side*.073,z), 'paint_light', 32)
    b.cyl('reduction-cover', radius*.78, .055, (x,y+side*.095,z), 'gunmetal', rot=Y_AXIS, verts=32, bevel=.012)
    b.cyl('oil-access-cap', radius*.35, .018, (x,y+side*.13,z), 'paint_dark', rot=Y_AXIS, verts=16, bevel=.003)
    _nuts(b,'housing-bolts',(x,y+side*.098,z),radius*.91,10,.013)
    b.cyl('hub-centre-step',radius*.47,.022,(x,y+side*.122,z),'paint',rot=Y_AXIS,verts=24,bevel=.005)
    ribs = Batch(b,'housing-ribs','paint_dark')
    for k in range(10):
        a=2*PI*k/10
        ribs.box((.03,.10,.04),(x+radius*.97*math.cos(a),y,z+radius*.97*math.sin(a)),(0,-a,0))
    ribs.done(bevel=.004)


def mob_b(b, m):
    """High-Torque Drivetrain: portal hubs, jointed half-shafts and segmented guards."""
    for x,y,s in _wheels(m):
        face = y+s*(m.tyre_w*.49+.025)
        _hub(b,(x,face,m.wheel_r),s)
        inner = y-s*.45
        _bar(b,'half-shaft',(x,inner,m.wheel_r),(x,face-s*.08,m.wheel_r),.06)
        b.box('half-shaft-armour',(.19,.31,.18),(x,inner+s*.13,m.wheel_r),'paint_dark',bevel=.028)
        for yy in (inner-.035*s,inner+.30*s):
            b.cyl('universal-joint',.09,.10,(x,yy,m.wheel_r),'gunmetal',rot=Y_AXIS,verts=16,bevel=.008)
        if _card(m):
            b.box('differential-case',(.42,.37,.37),(x,inner-s*.16,m.wheel_r),'paint',bevel=.020)
            _hub(b,(x,inner-s*.35,m.wheel_r),-s,.18)
            # One wheel station plus a connected longitudinal shaft (readable card kit).
            _bar(b,'propeller-shaft',(x-.75,inner-s*.16,m.wheel_r),(x,inner-s*.16,m.wheel_r),.065)
            b.box('propeller-guard',(.48,.18,.18),(x-.48,inner-s*.16,m.wheel_r),'paint',bevel=.027)
            _nuts(b,'differential-bolts',(x,inner-s*.41,m.wheel_r),.14,8,.012)
    if not _card(m):
        axles=sorted(m.axles)
        for a,c in zip(axles,axles[1:]):
            _bar(b,'propeller-shaft',(a,0,m.wheel_r-.16),(c,0,m.wheel_r-.16),.075)
            b.box('driveline-guard',(c-a-.28,.25,.14),((a+c)/2,0,m.wheel_r-.18),'paint_dark',bevel=.025)



def _brake_hub(b, at, side):
    """Vented brake rotor and exposed wheel studs, distinct from B's portal casing."""
    x,y,z=at
    b.cyl('brake-rotor',.24,.055,at,'gunmetal',rot=Y_AXIS,verts=40,bevel=.004)
    _ring(b,'rotor-wear-face',.243,.098,.008,(x,y+side*.033,z),'steel',48)
    b.cyl('bearing-hub',.13,.12,(x,y+side*.04,z),'paint_dark',rot=Y_AXIS,verts=32,bevel=.01)
    b.cyl('bearing-dust-cap',.084,.028,(x,y+side*.112,z),'paint',rot=Y_AXIS,verts=24,bevel=.007)
    _nuts(b,'wheel-studs',(x,y+side*.064,z),.174,10,.015)
    vents=Batch(b,'rotor-vent-vanes','black')
    vent_count=12 if geo.REALTIME else 24
    for k in range(vent_count):
        a=k*2*PI/vent_count
        vents.box((.022,.042,.009),(x+.239*math.cos(a),y,z+.239*math.sin(a)),(0,-a,0))
    vents.done()


def mob_d(b, m):
    """Heavy-Duty Suspension: wishbones, ribbed upright, coil and yellow damper."""
    for x,y,s in _wheels(m):
        r=m.wheel_r
        # Fitted springs live inside the tyre plane, below the side-armour band.
        face=y+s*(m.tyre_w*.5+.028)
        inner=face-s*.48
        _brake_hub(b,(x,face,r),s)
        b.box('steering-upright',(.15,.13,.51),(x,face-s*.07,r+.035),'paint',bevel=.027)
        for h in (-.22,.36):
            for dx in (-.20,.20):
                _bar(b,'wishbone',(x,face-s*.08,r+h),(x+dx,inner,r+h+.015),.045,'paint')
                b.cyl('wishbone-bushing',.062,.09,(x+dx,inner,r+h+.015),'rubber',rot=X_AXIS,verts=16,bevel=.006)
                b.cyl('pivot-pin',.032,.11,(x+dx,inner,r+h+.015),'steel',rot=X_AXIS,verts=6,bevel=0)
        b.box('chassis-clevis',(.48,.09,.66),(x,inner,r+.10),'paint_dark',bevel=.023)
        sy=face-s*.29
        for h in (-.14,.39):
            b.cyl('spring-seat',.116,.037,(x,sy,r+h),'paint',verts=24,bevel=.009)
        _bar(b,'spring-guide',(x,sy,r-.12),(x,sy,r+.39),.05,'gunmetal')
        coil_steps = 48 if geo.REALTIME else 96
        coil=[(x+.085*math.cos(i*12*PI/coil_steps),sy+.085*math.sin(i*12*PI/coil_steps),r-.12+i*.49/coil_steps) for i in range(coil_steps+1)]
        _pipe(b, 'heavy-coil',coil,.022,'paint_light')
        dx=x+(.22 if _card(m) else .34)
        damper_y=sy-s*.055 if _card(m) else face+s*.07
        _bar(b,'yellow-damper',(dx,damper_y,r-.12),(dx,damper_y,r+.20),.049,'yellow')
        _bar(b,'chrome-piston',(dx,damper_y,r+.19),(dx,damper_y,r+.40),.022,'chrome')
        if not _card(m):
            _pipe(b,'upper-damper-bracket',[(dx,inner,r+.65),(dx,damper_y,r+.65),(dx,damper_y,r+.42)],.025,'paint')
            _bar(b,'lower-damper-bracket',(x,face,r-.10),(dx,damper_y,r-.15),.025,'paint',12)
        for h in (-.15,.42):
            b.cyl('damper-eye',.05,.075,(dx,damper_y,r+h),'yellow',rot=Y_AXIS,verts=16,bevel=.008)
            b.cyl('damper-eye-pin',.023,.084,(dx,damper_y,r+h),'steel',rot=Y_AXIS,verts=6,bevel=0)
        _bar(b,'cv-shaft',(x,face-s*.07,r),(x,inner,r),.05)
        for j in range(5):
            b.cyl('cv-boot-rib',.075-abs(j-2)*.005,.026,(x,face-s*(.15+j*.029),r),'rubber',rot=Y_AXIS,verts=16,bevel=.006)
        _bar(b,'tie-rod',(x-.16,face-s*.08,r-.10),(x-.22,inner,r-.10),.023,'steel')


def _jerrycan(b, at, side, scale):
    """Pressed can with X ribs, recessed handle and filler neck."""
    x,y,z=at
    b.box('jerrycan',(.19*scale,.13*scale,.30*scale),at,'paint_dark',bevel=.025*scale)
    for sign in (-1,1):
        _bar(b,'pressed-can-rib',(x-.062*scale,y+side*.071*scale,z+sign*.10*scale),
             (x+.062*scale,y+side*.071*scale,z-sign*.10*scale),.009*scale,'paint',8)
    _pipe(b, 'can-handle',[(x-.05*scale,y,z+.15*scale),(x-.05*scale,y,z+.20*scale),
                         (x+.045*scale,y,z+.20*scale),(x+.045*scale,y,z+.15*scale)],.012*scale,'paint')
    b.cyl('can-cap',.029*scale,.023*scale,(x+.058*scale,y,z+.158*scale),'gunmetal',verts=16,bevel=.003)


def mob_e(b, m):
    """Long-Range Propulsion: twin chamfered tanks, cradle straps and can rack."""
    x0,x1,z,hw=m.tanks
    length=x1-x0
    # Outboard of tyre faces; tank tops stop below the armour slot.
    height=.50 if _card(m) else .40
    for s in _sides(m):
        y=s*(max(hw,m.track+m.tyre_w*.5 if not _card(m) else hw)+.235)
        cx=(x0+x1)/2
        for k in (-1,1):
            tx=cx+k*length*.245
            ln=length*.45
            b.box('armoured-fuel-tank',(ln,.34,height),(tx,y,z),'paint',bevel=.055,segments=3)
            for dx in (-ln*.32,ln*.32):
                b.box('tank-strap',( .035,.37,height+.018),(tx+dx,y,z),'paint_dark',bevel=.035)
                b.box('strap-buckle',(.065,.025,.065),(tx+dx,y+s*.198,z+.05),'steel',bevel=.007)
            b.cyl('fuel-filler',.055,.028,(tx,y,z+height/2+.018),'gunmetal',verts=24,bevel=.007)
            b.cyl('filler-lock',.065,.014,(tx,y,z+height/2+.033),'paint',verts=16,bevel=.003)
            b.box('tank-cradle',(ln+.02,.43,.045),(tx,y,z-height/2-.03),'paint_dark',bevel=.012)
            for dx in (-ln*.3,ln*.3):
                b.box('tank-hanger',(.05,.05,height+.06),(tx+dx,y-s*.20,z),'paint_dark',bevel=.01)
            can_scale=1 if _card(m) else .77
            for dx in (-.105,.105) if _card(m) else (0,):
                _jerrycan(b,(tx+dx,y+s*.28,z-.01),s,can_scale)
        if not _card(m):
            # Cantilever from behind the last tyre, with real hull contact.
            for fraction in (.12,.30):
                sx=x0+length*fraction
                b.box('hull-tank-outrigger',(.065,abs(y)-hw+.08,.065),
                      (sx,s*(abs(y)+hw)/2,z-.10),'paint_dark',bevel=.01)
                b.box('hull-anchor-plate',(.13,.035,.25),(sx,s*hw,z-.025),'paint',bevel=.009)
                for dz in (-.10,.07):
                    b.cyl('hull-anchor-bolt',.017,.035,(sx,s*(hw+.027),z+dz),'steel',rot=Y_AXIS,verts=6,bevel=0)
        b.box('can-rack-base',(length*.93,.18,.04),(cx,y+s*.28,z-.19),'paint',bevel=.008)
        b.box('can-retaining-strap',(length*.94,.025,.036),(cx,y+s*.36,z),'gunmetal',bevel=.005)
        for dx in (-length*.45,length*.45):
            _pipe(b, 'can-rack-end',[(cx+dx,y+s*.17,z-.18),(cx+dx,y+s*.38,z-.18),
                                    (cx+dx,y+s*.38,z+.14)],.014,'paint')
        _pipe(b, 'fuel-crossover',[(cx-.10,y-s*.16,z+.08),(cx-.08,y-s*.21,z-.10),
                                 (cx+.08,y-s*.21,z-.10),(cx+.10,y-s*.16,z+.08)],.016,'rubber')


def _chain_link(bm, centre, u, v, long=.030, short=.017, wire=.007):
    """Six-segment forged oval, four-sided wire: 48 triangles per open link."""
    c,u,v=Vector(centre),Vector(u),Vector(v)
    n=u.cross(v).normalized()
    rings=[]
    outline=6 if geo.REALTIME else 12
    for i in range(outline):
        a=2*PI*i/outline
        p=c+u*(long*math.cos(a))+v*(short*math.sin(a))
        radial=(u*math.cos(a)+v*math.sin(a)).normalized()
        rings.append([bm.verts.new(p+wire*(radial*math.cos(j*PI/2)+n*math.sin(j*PI/2))) for j in range(4)])
    for i in range(outline):
        for j in range(4):
            bm.faces.new((rings[i][j],rings[i][(j+1)%4],rings[(i+1)%outline][(j+1)%4],rings[(i+1)%outline][j]))


def mob_g(b, m):
    """Adaptive Traction: interlocked cross chains, side chain and hub-fed CTIS."""
    for x,y,s in _wheels(m):
        r,w=m.wheel_r,m.tyre_w
        if _card(m):
            _tyre(b,m,x,y)
            # Dish with a depressed centre, visibly heavier than C's open alloy rim.
            b.revolve('steel-wheel-dish',[(.08,s*w*.36),(.19,s*w*.32),(.30,s*w*.39),
                       (.35,s*w*.45),(.37,s*w*.43),(.37,-s*w*.35)],(x,y,r),'paint_dark',steps=48)
            _ring(b,'wheel-bead',.37,.019,.027,(x,y+s*w*.43,r),'paint',48)
            _nuts(b,'wheel-nuts',(x,y+s*w*.39,r),.16,10,.017)
        links=bmesh.new()
        for k in range(10):
            a=2*PI*k/10
            radial=Vector((math.cos(a),0,math.sin(a)))
            tangent=Vector((-math.sin(a),0,math.cos(a)))
            for j in range(5):
                yy=(j-2)*w/4
                rr=r+.009-(.038 if abs(j-2)==2 else 0)
                centre=Vector((x,y+yy,r))+radial*rr
                v=radial if j%2 else tangent
                _chain_link(links,centre,(0,1,0),v,long=w/7,short=.019,wire=.008)
        # Linked outer sidewall chain; inner side gets a continuous retaining cable.
        for k in range(20):
            a=2*PI*k/20
            radial=Vector((math.cos(a),0,math.sin(a)))
            tangent=Vector((-math.sin(a),0,math.cos(a)))
            _chain_link(links,(x+(r-.052)*math.cos(a),y+s*w*.52,r+(r-.052)*math.sin(a)),
                        tangent,(0,1,0) if k%2 else radial,long=.091,short=.016,wire=.007)
        bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals(links,faces=links.faces)
        b._mesh('forged-chain-links',links,'steel',(0,0,0),(0,0,0),0,0,True)
        buckles=Batch(b,'chain-tensioners','gunmetal')
        for sign in (-1,1):
            buckles.box((.045,.026,.06),(x+sign*(r-.052),y+s*w*.55,r))
        buckles.done(bevel=.005)
        # Low-poly annular inner retainer avoids an expensive smooth curve ring.
        _ring(b,'inner-chain-retainer',r-.048,.012,.017,(x,y-s*w*.50,r),'gunmetal',48)
        face=y+s*(w*.49+.028)
        b.cyl('ctis-hub',.09,.065,(x,face,r),'paint',rot=Y_AXIS,verts=24,bevel=.013)
        b.cyl('rotary-air-union',.028,.085,(x,face+s*.047,r),'steel',rot=Y_AXIS,verts=16,bevel=.006)
        _pipe(b, 'inflation-hose',[(x,face+s*.085,r),(x+.09,face+s*.095,r-.13),
                               (x+.15,face+s*.07,r-.27),(x+.25,face,r-.28)],.014,'rubber')
        b.cyl('rim-air-valve',.024,.04,(x+.25,face,r-.28),'steel',rot=Y_AXIS,verts=12,bevel=.003)
```

```python
"""Protection kits: bevelled armour, service hardware and open protective grids.

Only Mounts supplies vehicle coordinates. Card displays retain full assemblies;
roof kits use the free forward centre bay between the equipment stations in situ.
"""
import math

import bmesh
from mathutils import Matrix, Vector

from ..geo import Batch, Builder
from .common import PI, _card, _sides

HEAVY_PLATE = 0.065
LIGHT_PLATE = 0.025
LAYER_PITCH = 0.096
SIDE_CLEARANCE = 0.39
ROOF_HALF_WIDTH = 0.15
ENGINE_RESERVE = 0.73
MESH_PITCH = 0.09


def _bolt(washers, heads, p, axis=(0, 0, 1), radius=0.021):
    """A dark seating washer and a contrasting hexagonal fastener."""
    normal = Vector(axis)
    rot = normal.to_track_quat('Z', 'Y').to_euler()
    washers.cyl(radius * 1.35, 0.009, p, rot, verts=12)
    heads.cyl(radius, 0.019, Vector(p) + normal * 0.012, rot, verts=6)


def _hardware(b):
    return Batch(b, 'seating-washers', 'steel'), Batch(b, 'hex-fasteners', 'gunmetal')


def _finish(*batches):
    for batch in batches:
        batch.done()


def _eye(b, name, p, radius=0.065):
    """Extruded lifting eye with a real through-hole, not a painted circle."""
    bm = bmesh.new()
    rings = []
    for depth, r in ((-.026, radius), (-.026, radius*.48), (.026, radius), (.026, radius*.48)):
        rings.append([bm.verts.new((r*math.cos(i*PI/6), depth, r*math.sin(i*PI/6))) for i in range(12)])
    for a,c in ((0,1),(2,0),(1,3),(3,2)):
        for i in range(12):
            j=(i+1)%12
            bm.faces.new((rings[a][i],rings[a][j],rings[c][j],rings[c][i]))
    bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals(bm, faces=list(bm.faces))
    return b._mesh(name,bm,'paint_dark',p,(0,0,0),0,2,False)


def _panel(b, name, x0, x1, z0, z1, y, thickness, mat='paint', chamfer=.07):
    """Clipped plate corners expose the rail and avoid a featureless box silhouette."""
    c=min(chamfer,(z1-z0)*.22,(x1-x0)*.15)
    profile=[(x0+c,z0),(x1-c,z0),(x1,z0+c),(x1,z1-c),(x1-c,z1),(x0+c,z1),(x0,z1-c),(x0,z0+c)]
    return b.wedge(name,profile,thickness,(0,y,0),mat,bevel=.007,segments=3)


def _side_armour(b,m,heavy):
    x0,x1,z0,z1,hw=m.side
    length=x1-x0
    card=_card(m)
    if card:
        display=Builder(b.layer,b.m)
        display.matrix=b.matrix @ Matrix.Translation((0,0,.2075 if heavy else -.025))
        b=display
    # Clear the permanent jerrycans and stowage on the sponson.
    inner=hw+(.055 if card else SIDE_CLEARANCE)
    washers,heads=_hardware(b)
    rails=Batch(b,'armour-carrier-rails','paint_dark')
    rows=2 if card else 1
    row_h=(z1-z0)/rows
    columns=4 if heavy else 3
    layers=2 if heavy else 1
    for side in _sides(m):
        for zz in (z0+.05,z1-.05):
            rails.box((length-.08,.055,.045),((x0+x1)/2,side*(inner-.04),zz))
        for f in (.08,.52,.94):
            xx=x0+length*f
            for zz in (z0+.07,z1-.07):
                rails.box((.075,inner-hw,.045),(xx,side*(hw+(inner-hw)/2),zz))
        for layer in range(layers):
            thick=HEAVY_PLATE if heavy else LIGHT_PLATE
            yy=side*(inner+layer*LAYER_PITCH)
            # Staggered joints remain inside the slot at both ends.
            edges=[x0+.02]+[x0+length*(k/columns+(.065 if layer else 0)) for k in range(1,columns)]+[x1-.02]
            for row in range(rows):
                a=z0+row*row_h+.025
                c=z0+(row+1)*row_h-.025
                for k,(left,right) in enumerate(zip(edges,edges[1:])):
                    left+=.008; right-=.008
                    _panel(b,'outer-armour' if layer else 'backing-armour',left,right,a,c,yy,thick,
                           'paint' if layer or not heavy else 'paint_dark')
                    for xx in (left+.065,right-.065):
                        for zz in (a+.06,c-.06):
                            _bolt(washers,heads,(xx,yy+side*(thick/2+.006),zz),(0,side,0),.018 if card else .022)
            for f in (.15,.55,.9):
                xx=x0+length*f
                rails.box((.1,.07,.09),(xx,yy,z1-.04))
                _eye(b,'lifting-eye',(xx,yy,z1+.012),.046)
        for xx in (x0+.06,x1-.06):
            rails.box((.08,.12,(z1-z0)*.58),(xx,side*(inner-.07),(z0+z1)/2))
            for zz in (z0+.1,z1-.1):
                _bolt(washers,heads,(xx,side*(inner+.06),zz),(0,side,0),.025)
    rails.done(bevel=.005); _finish(washers,heads)
    if card and heavy:
        # Card-only shipping pallet, with real fork pockets between bearer blocks.
        pallet=Batch(b,'shipping-pallet','wood')
        for xx in (x0+.13,0,x1-.13):
            for yy in (-.30,.12):
                pallet.box((.23,.2,.13),(xx,yy,z0-.11))
        for yy in (-.34,-.13,.08,.25):
            pallet.box((length+.08,.14,.045),((x0+x1)/2,yy,z0-.025))
        for yy in (-.3,.12):
            pallet.box((length+.08,.19,.035),((x0+x1)/2,yy,z0-.19))
        pallet.done(bevel=.008)


def pro_a(b,m):
    """Two staggered armour layers on isolation rails; pallet on the card mount."""
    _side_armour(b,m,True)


def pro_c(b,m):
    """Single thin skin of broad, chamfered bolted plates with lifting eyes."""
    _side_armour(b,m,False)


def pro_e(b,m):
    """Three replaceable slat cassettes with return bars, isolation pads and brackets."""
    x0,x1,z0,z1,hw=m.side
    length=x1-x0; height=z1-z0
    washers,heads=_hardware(b)
    slats=Batch(b,'horizontal-slat-cassettes','paint')
    fittings=Batch(b,'cassette-brackets','paint_dark')
    pads=Batch(b,'isolator-pads','rubber')
    yy=hw+(.20 if _card(m) else .49)
    count=9 if _card(m) else 6
    for side in _sides(m):
        for k in range(4):
            xx=x0+.065+k*(length-.13)/3
            b.box('cassette-upright',(.055,.055,height),(xx,side*yy,(z0+z1)/2),'paint_dark',bevel=.008)
            for zz in (z0+.065,z1-.065):
                fittings.box((.09,yy-hw,.045),(xx,side*(hw+(yy-hw)/2),zz))
                pads.box((.10,.055,.08),(xx,side*(yy-.12),zz))
                b.cyl('isolator-hinge',.033,.10,(xx,side*(yy-.085),zz),'rubber',rot=(0,PI/2,0),verts=16,bevel=0)
                for dx in (-.055,.055):
                    b.cyl('hinge-collar',.038,.018,(xx+dx,side*(yy-.085),zz),'paint_dark',rot=(0,PI/2,0),verts=16,bevel=0)
                fittings.box((.11,.035,.1),(xx,side*(yy+.025),zz))
                _bolt(washers,heads,(xx,side*(yy+.048),zz),(0,side,0),.019)
        for row in range(count):
            zz=z0+.02+row*(height-.04)/(count-1)
            for k in range(3):
                left=x0+.065+k*(length-.08)/3
                right=x0+.015+(k+1)*(length-.08)/3
                slats.box((right-left,.025,min(.035,height/(count*2))),((left+right)/2,side*yy,zz))
            for xx in (x0+.04,x1-.04):
                slats.box((.025,yy-hw-.025,min(.035,height/(count*2))),(xx,side*(hw+(yy-hw)/2),zz))
    slats.done(bevel=.004); fittings.done(bevel=.004); pads.done(bevel=.008); _finish(washers,heads)


def _front_frame(b,m):
    """Local X points across the glacis, Y up its rake, Z outward."""
    x,z0,z1,hw=m.front_face
    if _card(m):
        origin=Vector((x,0,z0-.0063)); up=Vector((-.35,0,.94)); height=(z1-z0)*1.5
    else:
        # Hull nose and roof-edge mounts define the slope, without hull constants.
        origin=Vector((m.front-.025,0,z1-.08))
        up=Vector((m.roof_span[1]-.02-origin.x,0,m.roof_span[2]-origin.z)).normalized()
        height=(Vector((m.roof_span[1],0,m.roof_span[2]))-origin).length*.91
    across=Vector((0,1,0)); normal=across.cross(up)
    local=Builder(b.layer,b.m)
    local.matrix=b.matrix @ Matrix.Translation(origin) @ Matrix((across,up,normal)).transposed().to_4x4()
    return local,hw,height


def pro_b(b,m):
    """Raked composite tiles with dark laminate edges and two framed vision guards."""
    q,hw,height=_front_frame(b,m)
    washers,heads=_hardware(q)
    if not _card(m):
        for u in (-hw*.73,hw*.73):
            for v in (height*.12,height*.64):
                q.box('glacis-mount-shoe',(.12,.15,.18),(u,v,-.065),'paint_dark',bevel=.012)
    q.box('composite-subframe',(hw*1.96,height,.035),(0,height/2,.024),'paint_dark',bevel=.012)
    pw=hw*1.88/3; ph=height*.57/2
    for row in range(2):
        for col in range(3):
            u=-pw+(col*pw); v=.035+ph*(row+.5)
            q.box('laminate-core',(pw-.023,ph-.022,.085),(u,v,.078),'gunmetal',bevel=.009)
            q.box('composite-face',(pw-.035,ph-.03,.032),(u,v,.137),'paint',bevel=.012)
            for du in (-pw/2+.07,pw/2-.07):
                for dv in (-ph/2+.05,ph/2-.05):
                    _bolt(washers,heads,(u+du,v+dv,.158),radius=.018)
    for side in (-1,1):
        u=side*hw*.46; v=height*.79; width=hw*.84; h=height*.29
        q.box('vision-seal',(width,h,.035),(u,v,.065),'rubber',bevel=.016)
        q.box('protected-vision',(width-.07,h-.055,.02),(u,v,.09),'glass',bevel=.008)
        for du in (-width/2,width/2):
            q.box('guard-jamb',(.045,h+.05,.075),(u+du,v,.13),'paint_dark',bevel=.007)
        for dv in (-h/2,h/2):
            q.box('guard-sill',(width+.04,.045,.075),(u,v+dv,.13),'paint_dark',bevel=.007)
        bars=Batch(q,'vision-guard-bars','gunmetal')
        for j in range(4): bars.box((width,.014,.018),(u,v-h*.36+j*h*.24,.18))
        for j in (-1,0,1): bars.box((.016,h,.02),(u+j*width*.28,v,.19))
        bars.done(bevel=.003)
        for du in (-width/2,width/2):
            for dv in (-h/2,h/2): _bolt(washers,heads,(u+du,v+dv,.176),radius=.018)
    _finish(washers,heads)


def _roof_bay(m):
    """Full display kit, or the unoccupied centre of the forward crew roof."""
    x0,x1,z,hw=m.roof_span
    if _card(m): return x0,x1,z,hw
    # This narrow strip clears both the driver hatch and the largest engine pack.
    left=max(m.roof[0]+.95,m.deck[0]+m.deck_size[0]/2+.10,m.roof2[0]+.32)
    return min(left,x1-.38),x1-.035,z,min(ROOF_HALF_WIDTH,hw*.3)


def pro_d(b,m):
    """Heavy crew roof cassette with raised coping, hatch and hinged armoured visors."""
    x0,x1,z,hw=_roof_bay(m); length=x1-x0; cx=(x0+x1)/2
    if _card(m):
        display=Builder(b.layer,b.m)
        display.matrix=b.matrix @ Matrix.Translation((0,0,.60))
        b=display
    else:
        fitted=Builder(b.layer,b.m)
        fitted.matrix=b.matrix @ Matrix.Translation((0,m.engine[1]-ENGINE_RESERVE,0))
        b=fitted
    washers,heads=_hardware(b)
    b.box('roof-gasket',(length,hw*2,.02),(cx,0,z+.01),'rubber',bevel=.01)
    b.box('crew-roof',(length,hw*2,.09),(cx,0,z+.065),'paint',bevel=.016)
    for side in (-1,1):
        b.box('raised-roof-edge',(length,.035,.11),(cx,side*(hw-.025),z+.14),'paint_dark',bevel=.01)
    b.box('rear-coping',(.04,hw*2,.11),(x0+.022,0,z+.14),'paint_dark',bevel=.01)
    r=min(length*.23,hw*.53)
    b.cyl('hatch-seal',r*1.1,.025,(cx,0,z+.125),'gunmetal',verts=48,bevel=.005)
    b.cyl('escape-hatch',r,.028,(cx,0,z+.15),'paint_light',verts=48,bevel=.009)
    for angle in range(0,360,60):
        a=math.radians(angle)
        _bolt(washers,heads,(cx+math.cos(a)*r*.83,math.sin(a)*r*.83,z+.171),radius=.014)
    b.box('hatch-hinge',(.05,r*.9,.05),(cx-r,0,z+.17),'paint_dark',bevel=.008)
    b.tube('hatch-handle',[(cx-.04,-r*.3,z+.17),(cx-.04,-r*.3,z+.21),(cx+.04,-r*.3,z+.21),(cx+.04,-r*.3,z+.17)],.009,'steel',smooth=False)
    for side in (-1,1):
        for f in (.13,.85):
            xx=x0+length*f
            _bolt(washers,heads,(xx,side*(hw-.08),z+.115),radius=.018)
        if _card(m):
            # The display includes the upper crew-cell walls and paired side windows.
            b.box('cell-side-wall',(length,.065,.64),(cx,side*(hw-.05),z-.28),'paint',bevel=.018)
            for f in (.25,.75):
                xx=x0+length*f
                b.box('window-flange',(length*.44,.035,.50),(xx,side*(hw-.005),z-.28),'paint_dark',bevel=.025)
                b.box('window-seal',(length*.37,.025,.41),(xx,side*(hw+.018),z-.28),'rubber',bevel=.022)
                b.box('crew-window',(length*.33,.018,.35),(xx,side*(hw+.035),z-.28),'glass',bevel=.016)
                b.box('armoured-visor',(length*.46,.23,.045),(xx,side*(hw+.075),z+.018),'paint',rot=(side*.3,0,0),bevel=.01)
                for dx in (-length*.19,length*.19):
                    for zz in (z-.51,z-.05):
                        _bolt(washers,heads,(xx+dx,side*(hw+.032),zz),(0,side,0),.014)
                    b.cyl('visor-hinge',.025,.08,(xx+dx,side*hw,z+.052),'gunmetal',rot=(0,PI/2,0),verts=16,bevel=.004)
            b.box('cell-door-seam',(.016,.012,.54),(cx,side*(hw+.001),z-.30),'gunmetal',bevel=.002)
    if _card(m):
        q=Builder(b.layer,b.m)
        up=Vector((-.22,0,.975)).normalized()
        across=Vector((0,1,0))
        normal=across.cross(up)
        q.matrix=b.matrix @ Matrix.Translation((x1+.10,0,z-.60)) @ Matrix((across,up,normal)).transposed().to_4x4()
        trim=Batch(q,'front-cell-hardware','gunmetal')
        for side in (-1,1):
            u=side*hw*.49; width=hw*.9
            q.box('front-armour-surround',(width,.65,.07),(u,.325,.015),'paint',bevel=.023)
            q.box('front-window-gasket',(width-.12,.49,.027),(u,.325,.057),'rubber',bevel=.021)
            q.box('front-ballistic-glass',(width-.18,.43,.014),(u,.325,.075),'glass',bevel=.015)
            q.box('front-visor',(width+.03,.055,.25),(u,.63,.14),'paint_dark',rot=(.12,0,0),bevel=.009)
            for du in (-width*.41,width*.41):
                for v in (.07,.58): trim.cyl(.017,.02,(u+du,v,.065),verts=6)
            trim.box((width*.57,.012,.012),(u,.105,.09))
            trim.box((.013,.20,.015),(u-.12,.20,.09),(0,0,-.45))
        trim.done()
    _finish(washers,heads)


def _access_plate(b,size,loc,rot):
    """A rectangular plate with a real circular service opening and solid cut walls."""
    length,width,thick=size
    outer=[]
    for edge in range(4):
        for i in range(8):
            f=i/8
            outer.append(((length/2, -width/2+width*f),
                          (length/2-length*f,width/2),
                          (-length/2,width/2-width*f),
                          (-length/2+length*f,-width/2))[edge])
    bm=bmesh.new(); rings=[]
    radius=min(.085,width*.15)
    for z,inner in ((-thick/2,False),(-thick/2,True),(thick/2,False),(thick/2,True)):
        points=[]
        for x,y in outer:
            scale=radius/math.hypot(x,y) if inner else 1
            points.append(bm.verts.new((x*scale,y*scale,z)))
        rings.append(points)
    for a,c in ((0,1),(2,0),(1,3),(3,2)):
        for i in range(32):
            j=(i+1)%32
            bm.faces.new((rings[a][i],rings[a][j],rings[c][j],rings[c][i]))
    bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals(bm,faces=list(bm.faces))
    b._mesh('blast-service-opening',bm,'paint_dark',loc,rot,.003,2,False)


def pro_f(b,m):
    """Continuous V belly with segmented strike plates, keel and bolted attachment rails."""
    x0,x1,z,hw=m.belly; length=x1-x0; cx=(x0+x1)/2
    q=Builder(b.layer,b.m); q.matrix=b.matrix.copy()
    if _card(m):
        # Tip the display to expose its underside to the standard above-ground card camera.
        q.matrix=b.matrix @ Matrix.Translation((0,0,.63)) @ Matrix.Rotation(math.radians(215),4,'X') @ Matrix.Translation((0,0,-z))
    washers,heads=_hardware(q)
    depth=.19; angle=math.atan2(depth,hw); span=math.hypot(hw,depth)
    for side in (-1,1):
        rot=(side*angle,0,0)
        for k in range(3):
            xx=x0+(k+.5)*length/3
            if k==1:
                _access_plate(q,(length/3-.018,span,.047),(xx,side*hw/2,z-.065-depth/2),rot)
            else:
                q.box('blast-strike-plate',(length/3-.018,span,.047),(xx,side*hw/2,z-.065-depth/2),'paint_dark',rot=rot,bevel=.01)
            # Underside cross rails sit on the same V planes as the panels.
            for dx in (-length/6+.05,length/6-.05):
                q.box('blast-cross-rail',(.06,span,.025),(xx+dx,side*hw/2,z-.102-depth/2),'paint',rot=rot,bevel=.005)
                for f in (.17,.52,.86):
                    yy=side*hw*f; zz=z-.105-depth*(1-f)
                    _bolt(washers,heads,(xx+dx,yy,zz),(0,side*math.sin(angle),-math.cos(angle)),.02)
        # Interrupted rails leave 0.30 m passages for the half-shaft guards.
        spans = [(x0, x1)]
        for axle in m.axles:
            spans = [(a, c) for lo, hi in spans
                     for a, c in ((lo, min(hi, axle-.15)), (max(lo, axle+.15), hi))
                     if c-a > .02]
        for lo, hi in spans:
            q.box('belly-mount-rail',(hi-lo,.085,.09),((lo+hi)/2,side*(hw-.035),z-.015),'paint',bevel=.012)
        for lo, hi in spans:
            xx=(lo+hi)/2
            q.box('belly-clevis',(.14,.12,.11),(xx,side*(hw-.04),z+.005),'paint_dark',bevel=.009)
            _bolt(washers,heads,(xx,side*(hw+.025),z+.006),(0,side,0),.025)
    q.box('replaceable-keel',(length,.07,.055),(cx,0,z-.065-depth),'gunmetal',bevel=.012)
    _finish(washers,heads)


def pro_g(b,m):
    """Open bowed wire canopy with curved ribs, four gusseted feet and clamp straps."""
    x0,x1,z,hw=_roof_bay(m); length=x1-x0; cx=(x0+x1)/2
    if not _card(m):
        fitted=Builder(b.layer,b.m)
        fitted.matrix=b.matrix @ Matrix.Translation((0,m.engine[1]-ENGINE_RESERVE,0))
        b=fitted
    rise=min(.23,hw*.24); leg_h=.48 if _card(m) else .17
    washers,heads=_hardware(b)
    mesh=Batch(b,'open-canopy-mesh','gunmetal')
    ribs=Batch(b,'canopy-ribs','paint')
    def roof(y): return z+leg_h+rise*(1-(y/hw)**2)
    segments=12
    for xx in (x0+.03,cx,x1-.03):
        for j in range(segments):
            ya=-hw+2*hw*j/segments; yb=-hw+2*hw*(j+1)/segments
            dz=roof(yb)-roof(ya); dy=yb-ya
            ribs.box((.055,math.hypot(dy,dz)+.005,.04),(xx,(ya+yb)/2,(roof(ya)+roof(yb))/2),(math.atan2(dz,dy),0,0))
    for side in (-1,1):
        b.box('canopy-eave',(length,.05,.07),(cx,side*hw,roof(hw)),'paint',bevel=.01)
        for xx in (x0+.065,x1-.065):
            b.box('canopy-foot',(.18,.16,.035),(xx,side*(hw-.035),z+.0175),'paint_dark',bevel=.012)
            b.box('canopy-leg',(.055,.055,leg_h),(xx,side*(hw-.035),z+leg_h/2),'paint',bevel=.009)
            b.wedge('foot-gusset',[(-.07,0),(.07,0),(0,.12)],.03,(xx,side*(hw-.035),z+.03),'paint',bevel=.003)
            for dx in (-.055,.055): _bolt(washers,heads,(xx+dx,side*(hw-.035),z+.041),radius=.014)
            _bolt(washers,heads,(xx,side*(hw+.027),z+leg_h-.025),(0,side,0),.018)
    # Square-section wires spend twelve triangles per span, rather than tubes per crossing.
    nx=max(5,round(length/MESH_PITCH)); ny=max(6,round(hw*2/MESH_PITCH))
    wire=.009 if _card(m) else .006
    for j in range(1,ny):
        yy=-hw+2*hw*j/ny
        mesh.box((length,wire,wire),(cx,yy,roof(yy)+.026))
    for i in range(1,nx):
        xx=x0+length*i/nx
        for j in range(segments):
            ya=-hw+2*hw*j/segments; yb=-hw+2*hw*(j+1)/segments
            dz=roof(yb)-roof(ya); dy=yb-ya
            mesh.box((wire,math.hypot(dy,dz)+.002,wire),(xx,(ya+yb)/2,(roof(ya)+roof(yb))/2+.019),(math.atan2(dz,dy),0,0))
    for xx in (x0+.03,cx,x1-.03):
        for side in (-1,1):
            yy=side*(hw-.045)
            b.box('mesh-clamp',(.085,.15,.025),(xx,yy,roof(yy)+.047),'paint_dark',bevel=.004)
            _bolt(washers,heads,(xx,yy,roof(yy)+.064),radius=.014)
    ribs.done(bevel=.006); mesh.done(); _finish(washers,heads)
```

```python
"""Seven procedural SA assemblies with hardware sized for the shared roof slots."""
import math
from mathutils import Matrix, Vector
from ..geo import Batch, Builder
from .common import PI, _card

X_AXIS = (0, PI / 2, 0)
Y_AXIS = (PI / 2, 0, 0)


def _frame(b, at, yaw=0):
    """Local frame preserving the caller's transform, materials and layer."""
    local = Builder(b.layer, b.m, at, (0, 0, yaw))
    local.matrix = b.matrix @ local.matrix
    return local


def _optics(b, m):
    x, y, z = m.optics
    if _card(m):
        return _frame(b, (x, y, z), -.35)
    # Keep the shoe on the roof; cantilever the head forward over the glacis
    # to leave the auxiliary gun and its folding shield a separate envelope.
    support = _frame(b, (x + .205, y + .06, z))
    support.box('optics-deck-shoe', (.070, .050, .016), (0, 0, .008), 'paint_dark', bevel=.003)
    _bolts(support, 'optics-shoe-studs', [(a, c, .019) for a in (-.025, .025) for c in (-.015, .015)], .005)
    support.wedge('optics-riser', [(-.005, .016), (.025, .016), (.67, .27), (.67, .30), (-.005, .30)],
                  .055, (0, -.008, 0), 'paint_dark', bevel=.006)
    support.box('optics-cantilever', (.70, .075, .040), (.335, -.015, .30), 'paint', bevel=.008)
    support.box('optics-head-crossplate', (.14, .32, .040), (.645, .11, .30), 'paint', bevel=.008)
    return _frame(b, (x + .85, y + .28, z + .32))


def _bolts(b, name, points, radius=.012, rot=(0, 0, 0)):
    hardware = Batch(b, name, 'steel')
    for p in points:
        hardware.cyl(radius, radius * .65, p, rot, verts=6)
    hardware.done()


def _foot(b, size=(.28, .28), height=.035, name='mount-foot'):
    b.box(name, (*size, height), (0, 0, height / 2), 'paint_dark', bevel=.012)
    _bolts(b, name + '-bolts', [(sx * (size[0] / 2 - .025), sy * (size[1] / 2 - .025), height + .004)
                              for sx in (-1, 1) for sy in (-1, 1)])


def _ring(b, name, radius, depth, at, mat='gunmetal', axis='x', wall=.012, verts=32):
    """Closed section revolved into an open bore instead of opaque stacked discs."""
    profile = [(radius - wall, -depth / 2), (radius, -depth / 2), (radius, depth / 2),
               (radius - wall, depth / 2), (radius - wall, -depth / 2)]
    rot = (0, 0, -PI / 2) if axis == 'x' else (PI / 2, 0, 0)
    b.revolve(name, profile, at, mat, rot=rot, steps=verts)


def _lens(b, at, radius, name='lens'):
    """Recessed optical stack with open barrel, retaining rings and curved glass."""
    x, y, z = at
    _ring(b, name + '-barrel', radius, .042, at, wall=radius * .17)
    _ring(b, name + '-retainer', radius * .89, .011, (x + .016, y, z), 'black', wall=radius * .08)
    b.cyl(name + '-well', radius * .80, .006, (x - .018, y, z), 'black', rot=X_AXIS, verts=32, bevel=0)
    b.revolve(name + '-glass', [(radius * .78, 0), (radius * .55, .007), (0, .011)],
              (x - .010, y, z), 'glass', rot=(0, 0, -PI / 2), steps=32)


def _strut(b, name, start, end, radius, mat='paint', verts=12):
    a, c = Vector(start), Vector(end)
    delta = c - a
    b.cyl(name, radius, delta.length, (a + c) / 2, mat,
          rot=delta.to_track_quat('Z', 'Y').to_euler(), verts=verts, bevel=0)


def _cable(b, name, points, radius=.009):
    """Low-sided cable segments keep bounds and real-time tessellation predictable."""
    for a, c in zip(points, points[1:]):
        _strut(b, name, a, c, radius, 'cable', verts=8)


def _camera(b, size=1.0):
    """Day camera, sunshade, sealed rear plate and two-sided tilt bracket."""
    b = _frame(b, (0, 0, 0))
    b.matrix = b.matrix @ Matrix.Diagonal((size, size, size, 1))
    _foot(b, (.30, .28))
    b.cyl('camera-pan', .095, .065, (0, 0, .067), 'gunmetal', verts=32, bevel=.006 if size == 1 else 0)
    for side in (-1, 1):
        b.wedge('camera-cheek', [(-.09, .08), (.10, .08), (.09, .23), (.055, .30), (-.055, .30)],
                .025, (0, side * .117, 0), 'paint', bevel=.009)
        b.cyl('camera-pivot', .047, .04, (0, side * .137, .255), 'gunmetal', rot=Y_AXIS, verts=24, bevel=.004 if size == 1 else 0)
        _bolts(b, 'camera-pivot-cap', [(0, side * .16, .255)], .020, Y_AXIS)
    b.box('camera-gasket', (.31, .208, .20), (.025, 0, .285), 'rubber', bevel=.022)
    b.box('camera-case', (.29, .22, .22), (.01, 0, .285), 'paint', bevel=.028)
    b.box('camera-back', (.024, .211, .20), (-.15, 0, .285), 'paint_dark', bevel=.016)
    b.box('camera-face', (.026, .20, .20), (.164, 0, .285), 'gunmetal', bevel=.027)
    _lens(b, (.184, 0, .285), .080)
    b.box('camera-hood', (.35, .245, .021), (.05, 0, .407), 'paint', bevel=.009)
    for side in (-1, 1):
        b.wedge('camera-hood-wing', [(-.12, .40), (.22, .40), (.19, .30), (.10, .30), (-.12, .36)],
                .017, (0, side * .118, 0), 'paint', bevel=.006)
    _bolts(b, 'camera-face-screws', [(.181, y, z) for y in (-.075, .075) for z in (.212, .357)], .009, X_AXIS)
    _bolts(b, 'camera-lid-screws', [(x, y, .423) for x in (-.08, .12) for y in (-.095, .095)], .009)
    b.cyl('camera-connector', .027, .05, (-.18, 0, .27), 'gunmetal', rot=X_AXIS, verts=16, bevel=.003)
    _cable(b, 'camera-cable', [(-.207, 0, .27), (-.23, 0, .23), (-.23, 0, .11), (-.14, 0, .045)])


def sa_a(b, m):
    """Six hooded periscopes around a bolted cupola and articulated hatch hardware."""
    b = _optics(b, m)
    b.cyl('cupola-flange', .335, .055, (0, 0, .0275), 'paint_dark', verts=64, bevel=.008)
    b.cyl('cupola-body', .310, .175, (0, 0, .135), 'paint', verts=64, radius2=.274, bevel=.009)
    for k in range(6):

        f = _frame(b, (.268 * math.cos(a), .268 * math.sin(a), .143), a)

        f.box('periscope-glass', (.016, .147, .073), (.031, 0, 0), 'glass', bevel=.009)
        f.box('periscope-hood', (.092, .20, .021), (.025, 0, .065), 'paint', bevel=.005)

        for side in (-1, 1):

        _bolts(f, 'periscope-fasteners', [(.053, y, -.050) for y in (-.067, .067)], .009)
    _bolts(b, 'cupola-flange-bolts', [(.315 * math.cos(k * PI / 4), .315 * math.sin(k * PI / 4), .059)
                                    for k in range(8)], .012)
    b.cyl('hatch-seal', .269, .018, (0, 0, .236), 'rubber', verts=64, bevel=.003)
    b.cyl('hatch-rim', .279, .031, (0, 0, .254), 'paint_dark', verts=64, bevel=.008)

def _corner_frame(b, m, corner):
    """Deck feet and short outboard cantilevers clear the neighbouring optics slot."""
    x, y, z = corner
    if _card(m):
        return _frame(b, corner, -.35)
    middle = sum(p[0] for p in m.corners) / len(m.corners)
    yaw = 0 if x > middle else PI
    sign = (1 if y > 0 else -1) * (1 if yaw == 0 else -1)
    if yaw == 0:
        # Front feet bolt onto the existing smoke mounting plate, outside its tubes.
        f = _frame(b, (x + .065, y + sign * .04, z + .08))
        _foot(f, (.070, .070), .032, 'corner-foot')
        f.wedge('corner-outrigger', [(-.035, .03), (.26, .29), (.26, .33), (-.035, .07)], .070,
                (0, sign * .045, 0), 'paint_dark', bevel=.007)
        return _frame(f, (.23, sign * .075, .31))
    f = _frame(b, corner, yaw)
    _foot(f, (.11, .11), .032, 'corner-foot')
    f.wedge('corner-outrigger', [(-.05, .03), (.18, .11), (.18, .15), (-.05, .07)], .070,
            (0, sign * .045, 0), 'paint_dark', bevel=.007)
    return _frame(f, (.14, sign * .11, .13))

                                (.080, .167), (.037, .190), (0, .195)],

def sa_g(b, m):
    """Four bracket cameras with a finned, connector-equipped data concentrator."""
    centre = tuple(sum(p[k] for p in m.corners) / len(m.corners) for k in range(3))
    corners = [tuple(centre[k] + (p[k] - centre[k]) * (1.3 if k < 2 else 1) for k in range(3))

    for corner in corners:
        _camera(_corner_frame(b, m, corner), .64)
```

```python
"""SE_PROCESS cards (MPES §10.2): no vehicle geometry, so each card image is a machined process token.

The plaque's outline names the attribute it improves (hexagon SA, shield PRO, circle COM, square CAP,
octagon MOB) and a raised icon names the review, so all 21 tokens differ. Also the practice card TRAIN-CAP.
Icons are drawn in the plaque's (u, v) plane; the plaque faces the card camera.
"""
import math

from ..geo import Builder

PI = math.pi
FACE = -0.05  # y of the plaque's front face (the plaque faces -Y before turning to the camera)
STROKE = 0.028


def _p(u, v, lift=0.0):
    return (u, FACE - lift, v)


def _line(b, pts, r=STROKE, mat='yellow'):
    b.tube('icon', [_p(u, v, 0.02) for u, v in pts], r, mat, smooth=False)


def _curve(b, pts, r=STROKE, mat='yellow'):
    b.tube('icon', [_p(u, v, 0.02) for u, v in pts], r, mat)


def _arc(cx, cy, r, a0, a1, n=24):
    return [(cx + math.cos(a0 + (a1 - a0) * t / n) * r, cy + math.sin(a0 + (a1 - a0) * t / n) * r) for t in range(n + 1)]


def _dot(b, u, v, r=0.06, mat='yellow'):
    b.cyl('icon-dot', r, 0.05, _p(u, v, 0.02), mat, rot=(PI / 2, 0, 0), verts=24)


def _block(b, u, v, w, h, mat='yellow'):
    b.box('icon-block', (w, 0.05, h), _p(u, v, 0.02), mat, bevel=0.01)


ICONS = {
    'SE-A': lambda b: [_line(b, [(-0.2, y), (0.25, y)]) for y in (0.2, 0.0, -0.2)] + [_line(b, [(-0.36, y), (-0.32, y - 0.04), (-0.26, y + 0.05)], 0.02) for y in (0.2, 0.0, -0.2)],

    'SE-E': lambda b: (_curve(b, _arc(0, 0, 0.15, 0, 2 * PI)), [_block(b, math.cos(a) * 0.24, math.sin(a) * 0.24, 0.09, 0.09) for a in [k * PI / 4 for k in range(8)]]),
    'SE-F': lambda b: (_line(b, [(0, -0.28), (0, 0.22)]), _line(b, [(-0.3, 0.18), (0.3, 0.18)]), _curve(b, _arc(-0.27, 0.0, 0.1, PI, 2 * PI)), _curve(b, _arc(0.27, 0.0, 0.1, PI, 2 * PI)), _line(b, [(-0.15, -0.28), (0.15, -0.28)])),
    'SE-G': lambda b: (_curve(b, _arc(0, 0, 0.3, 0, 2 * PI)), _curve(b, _arc(0, 0, 0.18, 0, 2 * PI)), _dot(b, 0, 0)),
    'SE-H': lambda b: (_block(b, 0, 0.2, 0.22, 0.12), _block(b, -0.22, -0.2, 0.18, 0.12), _block(b, 0.22, -0.2, 0.18, 0.12), _line(b, [(0, 0.14), (0, 0.0), (-0.22, 0.0), (-0.22, -0.14)]), _line(b, [(0, 0.0), (0.22, 0.0), (0.22, -0.14)])),
    'SE-I': lambda b: (_line(b, [(0, 0.28), (0, -0.2)], 0.04), _line(b, [(-0.18, -0.02), (0, -0.25), (0.18, -0.02)], 0.04)),
    'SE-J': lambda b: (_line(b, [(-0.28, -0.18), (0.0, 0.0), (0.28, 0.18)]), _dot(b, -0.28, -0.18, 0.07), _dot(b, 0, 0, 0.07), _dot(b, 0.28, 0.18, 0.07)),
    'SE-K': lambda b: (_block(b, -0.13, 0, 0.22, 0.32), _block(b, 0.13, 0, 0.22, 0.32, 'steel'), _line(b, [(-0.04, 0.0), (0.04, 0.0)], 0.05)),

    'SE-S': lambda b: (_curve(b, _arc(0, 0, 0.26, 0, 2 * PI)), _line(b, [(0, 0.34), (0, -0.34)], 0.02), _line(b, [(-0.34, 0), (0.34, 0)], 0.02), _dot(b, 0, 0, 0.05)),
    'SE-T': lambda b: (_line(b, [(0, -0.2), (-0.3, -0.12), (-0.3, 0.22), (0, 0.14), (0.3, 0.22), (0.3, -0.12), (0, -0.2), (0, 0.14)])),

# Attribute each SE card improves (Appendix A) -> plaque outline.
OUTLINE = {'SA': 6, 'COM': 40, 'MOB': 8}


def _outline(effect):
    """Plaque outline as (u, v) points."""
    if effect == 'PRO':
        return [(-0.45, 0.42), (0.45, 0.42), (0.45, -0.05), (0.0, -0.5), (-0.45, -0.05)]
    if effect == 'CAP':
        return [(-0.44, -0.44), (0.44, -0.44), (0.44, 0.44), (-0.44, 0.44)]
    n = OUTLINE[effect]
    r = 0.5 if n != 8 else 0.48
    off = PI / 2 if n == 6 else PI / 8 if n == 8 else 0
    return [(math.cos(off + 2 * PI * k / n) * r, math.sin(off + 2 * PI * k / n) * r) for k in range(n)]


def token(mats, card_id, effect, yaw_deg):
    """Build card_id's plaque on a small stand, turned to face a camera at yaw_deg."""
    b = Builder(card_id, mats, (0, 0, 0.62), (0, 0, math.radians(yaw_deg)))
    pts = _outline(effect)
    # Wedge extrudes an (x, z) profile along Y: the plaque is 0.1 thick, centred on y = 0.
    b.wedge('plaque', pts, 0.1, (0, 0, 0), 'paint_dark', bevel=0.03, segments=3)
    inner = [(u * 0.86, v * 0.86) for u, v in pts]
    b.tube('border', [_p(u, v, 0.005) for u, v in inner + inner[:1]], 0.012, 'steel', smooth=False)
    for item in ICONS[card_id](b) or ():
        pass
    b.box('stand', (0.5, 0.36, 0.06), (0, 0.06, -0.55), 'gunmetal', bevel=0.02)
    b.box('stand-back', (0.08, 0.06, 0.4), (0, 0.12, -0.35), 'gunmetal', rot=(-0.35, 0, 0), bevel=0.01)
    return b


def practice(mats):
    """TRAIN-CAP: a training crate module with hazard bands, the practice lot's stand-in part."""
    b = Builder('TRAIN-CAP', mats)
    L, W, H = 1.6, 1.2, 0.9
    b.box('crate', (L, W, H), (0, 0, H / 2), 'paint', bevel=0.04, segments=3)
    for x in (-L / 2 + 0.12, L / 2 - 0.12):
        for k in range(4):
            b.box('band', (0.12, W + 0.02, 0.1), (x, 0, 0.15 + k * 0.2), 'yellow' if k % 2 == 0 else 'black', bevel=0.005)
    for side in (-1, 1):
        b.box('handle', (0.3, 0.04, 0.05), (0, side * (W / 2 + 0.03), H * 0.7), 'steel', bevel=0.01)
    b.box('lid-seam', (L + 0.01, W + 0.01, 0.02), (0, 0, H - 0.12), 'black', bevel=0.004)
    return b
```

```python
"""Render settings, studio lighting, cameras and layer visibility (MPES §10, §11).

Everything is procedural: no image files, HDRIs or downloads, so renders depend only on these
scripts and the pinned Blender version.
"""
import math

import bpy
from mathutils import Vector

SEED = 20261010


def reset():
    bpy.ops.wm.read_factory_settings(use_empty=True)
    scene = bpy.context.scene
    scene.unit_settings.system = 'METRIC'
    return scene


def use_gpu():
    prefs = bpy.context.preferences.addons['cycles'].preferences
    for kind in ('OPTIX', 'CUDA'):
        try:
            prefs.compute_device_type = kind
            prefs.get_devices()
        except TypeError:
            continue
        devices = [d for d in prefs.devices if d.type == kind]
        if devices:
            for d in prefs.devices:
                d.use = d.type == kind
            return kind
    return 'CPU'


def configure(width, height, samples):
    scene = bpy.context.scene
    scene.render.engine = 'CYCLES'
    device = use_gpu()
    scene.cycles.device = 'GPU' if device != 'CPU' else 'CPU'
    scene.cycles.samples = samples
    scene.cycles.seed = SEED
    scene.cycles.use_adaptive_sampling = False  # same samples everywhere: stable, repeatable noise
    scene.cycles.use_denoising = True
    scene.cycles.denoiser = 'OPENIMAGEDENOISE'
    scene.cycles.max_bounces = 8
    scene.cycles.transparent_max_bounces = 8
    scene.render.resolution_x, scene.render.resolution_y = width, height
    scene.render.resolution_percentage = 100
    scene.render.film_transparent = True
    settings = scene.render.image_settings
    settings.file_format = 'PNG'
    settings.color_mode = 'RGBA'
    settings.color_depth = '16'
    settings.compression = 15
    scene.view_settings.view_transform = 'AgX'
    for look in ('AgX - Medium High Contrast', 'Medium High Contrast'):
        try:
            scene.view_settings.look = look
            break
        except TypeError:
            continue
    scene.view_settings.exposure = -0.25
    return device


def world():
    """Dim neutral studio environment; reflections come from hidden light cards."""
    w = bpy.data.worlds.new('studio')
    w.use_nodes = True
    bg = w.node_tree.nodes['Background']
    bg.inputs['Color'].default_value = (0.045, 0.05, 0.055, 1)
    bg.inputs['Strength'].default_value = 1.0
    bpy.context.scene.world = w


def _area(name, location, target, size, energy, color=(1, 1, 1), shape='RECTANGLE', size_y=None):
    data = bpy.data.lights.new(name, 'AREA')
    data.shape = shape
    data.size = size
    if size_y is not None:
        data.size_y = size_y
    data.energy = energy
    data.color = color
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name, data)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.location = location
    direction = Vector(target) - Vector(location)
    obj.rotation_euler = direction.to_track_quat('-Z', 'Y').to_euler()
    obj['sea_layer'] = 'rig'
    return obj


def _card(name, location, target, size, strength):
    """Emissive panel seen only in reflections: gives paint and glass studio highlights."""
    mesh = bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
    half = size / 2
    mesh.from_pydata([(-half[0], -half[1], 0), (half[0], -half[1], 0), (half[0], half[1], 0), (-half[0], half[1], 0)], [], [(0, 1, 2, 3)])
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name, mesh)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.location = location
    obj.rotation_euler = (Vector(target) - Vector(location)).to_track_quat('Z', 'Y').to_euler()
    mat = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    mat.use_nodes = True
    nodes = mat.node_tree.nodes
    nodes.clear()
    out = nodes.new('ShaderNodeOutputMaterial')
    em = nodes.new('ShaderNodeEmission')
    em.inputs['Strength'].default_value = strength
    mat.node_tree.links.new(em.outputs[0], out.inputs['Surface'])
    mesh.materials.append(mat)
    obj.visible_camera = False
    obj.visible_shadow = False
    obj.visible_diffuse = False
    obj['sea_layer'] = 'rig'
    return obj


def studio(center=(0, 0, 1.2), scale=1.0):
    """Key, fill and rim area lights plus reflection cards, scaled to the subject."""
    c = Vector(center)
    s = scale
    _area('key', c + Vector((-6, -7, 7)) * s, c, 5 * s, 1150 * s * s, (1.0, 0.96, 0.9))
    _area('fill', c + Vector((8, -4, 3)) * s, c, 7 * s, 260 * s * s, (0.85, 0.9, 1.0))
    _area('rim', c + Vector((2, 9, 5)) * s, c, 6 * s, 900 * s * s, (0.9, 0.95, 1.0))
    _area('top', c + Vector((0, 0, 10)) * s, c, 8 * s, 320 * s * s)
    _card('strip-left', c + Vector((-9, -3, 4)) * s, c, Vector((1.2, 8)) * s, 6)
    _card('strip-right', c + Vector((9, -2, 5)) * s, c, Vector((1.2, 8)) * s, 4)
    _card('strip-top', c + Vector((0, -2, 11)) * s, c, Vector((10, 2)) * s, 3)


def ground():
    """Large shadow catcher: shadows and contact occlusion only, transparent elsewhere."""
    mesh = bpy.data.meshes.new('ground')
    r = 60
    mesh.from_pydata([(-r, -r, 0), (r, -r, 0), (r, r, 0), (-r, r, 0)], [], [(0, 1, 2, 3)])
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new('ground', mesh)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.is_shadow_catcher = True
    obj['sea_layer'] = 'rig'
    return obj


def camera(lens=50):
    data = bpy.data.cameras.new('camera')
    data.lens = lens
    data.sensor_width = 36
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new('camera', data)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    bpy.context.scene.camera = obj
    return obj


def aim(cam, target, yaw_deg, pitch_deg, distance):
    """Place the camera on a sphere around target. Yaw 0 looks at the vehicle's left side (−Y)."""
    yaw, pitch = math.radians(yaw_deg), math.radians(pitch_deg)
    t = Vector(target)
    cam.location = t + Vector((math.sin(yaw) * math.cos(pitch), -math.cos(yaw) * math.cos(pitch), math.sin(pitch))) * distance
    cam.rotation_euler = (t - cam.location).to_track_quat('-Z', 'Y').to_euler()


def fit(cam, target, yaw_deg, pitch_deg, objects, margin=1.08):
    """Aim from (yaw, pitch) and move the camera along its view axis until every bounding-box corner fits."""
    aim(cam, target, yaw_deg, pitch_deg, 50.0)
    depsgraph = bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get()
    coords = []
    for obj in objects:
        if obj.type not in {'MESH', 'CURVE'}:
            continue
        ev = obj.evaluated_get(depsgraph)
        coords.extend(obj.matrix_world @ Vector(c) for c in ev.bound_box)
    flat = [v for c in coords for v in c]
    location, _ = cam.camera_fit_coords(depsgraph, flat)
    forward = (cam.matrix_world.to_quaternion() @ Vector((0, 0, -1))).normalized()
    # Back off along the view axis so the subject fills 1/margin of the frame.
    centre = sum(coords, Vector()) / len(coords)
    distance = (Vector(location) - centre).dot(-forward)
    cam.location = Vector(location) - forward * distance * (margin - 1)


def bounds(objects):
    lo = Vector((1e9, 1e9, 1e9))
    hi = Vector((-1e9, -1e9, -1e9))
    depsgraph = bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get()
    for obj in objects:
        if obj.type not in {'MESH', 'CURVE'}:
            continue
        ev = obj.evaluated_get(depsgraph)
        for corner in ev.bound_box:
            p = obj.matrix_world @ Vector(corner)
            lo = Vector(map(min, lo, p))
            hi = Vector(map(max, hi, p))
    return lo, hi


def layer_objects(layer):
    return [o for o in bpy.context.scene.objects if o.get('sea_layer') == layer]


def show_layers(visible, catchers=()):
    """Render only `visible` layers; `catchers` layers become shadow catchers (hold out + receive shadows)."""
    for obj in bpy.context.scene.objects:
        layer = obj.get('sea_layer')
        if layer in (None, 'rig'):
            continue
        obj.hide_render = layer not in visible and layer not in catchers
        obj.is_shadow_catcher = layer in catchers


def render(path):
    bpy.context.scene.render.filepath = path
    bpy.ops.render.render(write_still=True)
```

```python
"""The fictional 8x8 armoured vehicle family (owner concepts, 2026-10-10): one hull, six mission variants.

A narrow lower hull between the wheels, wide sponsons over them, an inward-sloped upper hull, a long upper
glacis and a raked lower nose. Bolted appliqué plates cover the sides and glacis. Variants change only what
a mission needs in its base form: the troop carrier's lowered ramp and lit compartment, armoured windscreens
on the command and mine-clearing vehicles, and the recovery crane.

Axes: +X forward, -Y is the vehicle's left side, Z up, ground at Z = 0.
"""
import math

import bmesh

from mathutils import Vector

from ..geo import Batch, Builder, loft, mirror_ring, face_basis
from ..mounts import Mounts

AXLES = (2.3, 1.0, -0.85, -2.15)
R, TRACK, TYRE_W = 0.6, 1.08, 0.46
BACK, FRONT, TOP = -3.5, 3.5, 2.3
SPONSON, SPONSON_Z0, SPONSON_Z1 = 1.36, 1.36, 1.86
ROOF_FRONT, GLACIS_X, GLACIS_Z = 2.05, 2.95, 1.74
PI = math.pi



def _panel(b, name, origin, u, v, size, mat='paint', cols=1, rows=1):
    """Thin bevelled service plates with sparse perimeter fasteners, flush to a mount face."""
    basis = face_basis(u, v)
    o = Vector(origin)
    rot = basis.to_euler()
    bolts = Batch(b, name + '-fasteners', 'gunmetal', basis, o)
    for i in range(cols):
        for j in range(rows):
            w, h = size[0] / cols - .018, size[1] / rows - .018
            x, y = (i + .5) * size[0] / cols, (j + .5) * size[1] / rows
            b.box(name, (w, h, .018), o + basis @ Vector((x, y, .009)), mat, rot=rot, bevel=.006, segments=2)
            for dx in (-w / 2 + .055, w / 2 - .055):
                for dy in (-h / 2 + .05, h / 2 - .05):
                    bolts.cyl(.022, .012, (x + dx, y + dy, .021), verts=6)
            if w > .65:
                for dy in (-h / 2 + .05, h / 2 - .05):
                    bolts.cyl(.019, .012, (x, y + dy, .021), verts=6)
    bolts.done()


def _grille(b, name, origin, u, v, size):
    """Recessed dark vent with metal cross mesh and a bolted border."""
    basis = face_basis(u, v)
    o = Vector(origin)
    w, h = size
    rot = basis.to_euler()
    b.box(name+'-frame', (w, h, .024), o, 'paint_dark', rot=rot, bevel=.008)
    b.box(name+'-recess', (w-.06, h-.06, .01), o+basis@Vector((0,0,.017)), 'black', rot=rot, bevel=.002)
    mesh = Batch(b, name+'-mesh', 'gunmetal', basis, o)
    for k in range(int((w-.08)/.036)+1):
        mesh.box((.009,h-.07,.009), (-w/2+.04+k*.036,0,.027))
    for k in range(int((h-.08)/.055)+1):
        mesh.box((w-.07,.012,.01), (0,-h/2+.04+k*.055,.029))
    for x in (-w/2+.02,w/2-.02):
        for y in (-h/2+.02,h/2-.02):
            mesh.cyl(.016,.016,(x,y,.024),verts=6)
    mesh.done()


def _wheel(b, name, loc, side):
    """Six-point chamfered tread blocks, sidewall shoulders and a dished bolted rim; <3000 RT tris."""
    # The tread's outer corners stay inside the contracted 0.6 m envelope.
    c = Vector(loc)
    profile = [(.345,-.19),(.47,-.23),(.545,-.213),(.565,-.17),
               (.565,.17),(.545,.213),(.47,.23),(.345,.19)]
    b.revolve(name+'-tyre', profile, c, 'rubber', steps=64)
    tread = bmesh.new()
    shoulders = Batch(b,name+'-shoulders','tread',origin=c)
    # Six-point planform makes real bevel-like corners even when export removes bevel modifiers.
    footprint = [(-.069,-.062),(-.045,-.088),(.047,-.088),(.069,.062),(.045,.088),(-.047,.088)]
    for i in range(26):
        for sign in (-1,1):
            a=2*PI*(i+(.5 if sign>0 else 0))/26
            radial=Vector((math.cos(a),0,math.sin(a)))
            tangent=Vector((-math.sin(a),0,math.cos(a)))
            centre=c+radial*.567+Vector((0,sign*.097,0))
            rings=[]
            for h in (0,.028):
                rings.append([tread.verts.new(centre+tangent*x+Vector((0,y,0))+radial*h) for x,y in footprint])
            tread.faces.new(rings[0][::-1]); tread.faces.new(rings[1])
            for j in range(6):
                tread.faces.new((rings[0][j],rings[0][(j+1)%6],rings[1][(j+1)%6],rings[1][j]))
            shoulders.box((.082,.035,.053), (math.cos(a)*.536,sign*.211,math.sin(a)*.536), (0,-a,0))
    bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals(tread,faces=list(tread.faces))
    b._mesh(name+'-tread',tread,'tread',(0,0,0),(0,0,0),0,2,smooth=False)
    shoulders.done(bevel=.004)
    rim=[(.025,side*.13),(.19,side*.145),(.28,side*.175),(.324,side*.194),
         (.343,side*.206),(.354,side*.198),(.351,side*.18)]
    b.revolve(name+'-rim',rim,c,'paint_dark',steps=64)
    hub=b.cyl(name+'-hub',.133,.085,c+Vector((0,side*.173,0)),'paint',rot=(PI/2,0,0),verts=24,bevel=0)
    for face in hub.data.polygons:

        vents.box((.020,.008,.045),(math.cos(a)*.286,side*.184,math.sin(a)*.286),(0,-a,0))

    return [(0, 0.52), (0.6, 0.52), (0.8, 0.72), (0.8, 1.3), (SPONSON, SPONSON_Z0), (SPONSON, SPONSON_Z1), (1.1, top), (0, top)]


GLACIS = [(0, 0.6), (0.58, 0.6), (0.8, 0.78), (0.8, 1.3), (1.3, 1.36), (1.3, 1.6), (1.05, GLACIS_Z - 0.02), (0, GLACIS_Z)]
NOSE = [(0, 1.0), (0.55, 1.0), (0.78, 1.06), (0.78, 1.3), (1.05, 1.34), (1.05, 1.42), (0.95, 1.46), (0, 1.48)]


def _hull(b, mission):
    front = [(ROOF_FRONT, mirror_ring(_full())), (GLACIS_X, mirror_ring(GLACIS)), (FRONT, mirror_ring(NOSE))]
    if mission == 'TROOP':

        bulkhead = -1.3
        loft(b, 'hull', [(bulkhead, mirror_ring(_full())), *front], 'paint', bevel=0.04, smooth=False)
        shell = loft(b, 'compartment', [(BACK, mirror_ring(_full())), (bulkhead + 0.02, mirror_ring(_full()))], 'paint',
                     bevel=0, cap=False, smooth=False)

    else:
        loft(b, 'hull', [(BACK, mirror_ring(_full())), *front], 'paint', bevel=0.04, smooth=False)

def _compartment(b, bulkhead):
    """Lit troop compartment seen through the lowered ramp: floor, liner, folding seats, lamps, kit."""
    length = bulkhead - BACK
    mid = (bulkhead + BACK) / 2
    b.box('floor', (length, 1.5, 0.08), (mid, 0, 0.64), 'interior_dark', bevel=0.01)
    b.box('bulkhead-liner', (0.04, 1.6, 1.5), (bulkhead - 0.02, 0, 1.4), 'interior', bevel=0.01)

        b.box('grab-rail', (length * 0.8, 0.03, 0.03), (mid, side * 0.7, TOP - 0.2), 'steel', bevel=0.005)
        b.box('kit-bag', (0.5, 0.25, 0.3), (mid + 0.3, side * .99, TOP - 0.38), 'canvas', bevel=0.06)
    for y in (-.41,.41):
        b.box('jump-seat-back',(.10,.36,.48),(bulkhead-.11,y,1.57),'canvas',bevel=.04)
        b.box('jump-seat-pad',(.37,.36,.085),(bulkhead-.30,y,1.29),'canvas',bevel=.025)
        b.box('jump-seat-belt',(.014,.035,.40),(bulkhead-.168,y,1.57),'black',bevel=.003)
        b.box('jump-seat-bracket',(.31,.045,.06),(bulkhead-.22,y,1.20),'gunmetal',bevel=.008)
    belts=Batch(b,'seat-belts','black')
    buckles=Batch(b,'seat-buckles','steel')
    for side in (-1,1):
        for k in range(4):
            x=bulkhead-.35-k*.5
            for dx in (-.12,.12):
                belts.box((.034,.014,.49),(x+dx,side*1.092,1.75))
            belts.box((.31,.02,.035),(x,side*1.085,1.54))
            buckles.box((.055,.026,.055),(x,side*1.07,1.54))
    belts.done(); buckles.done(bevel=.004)
    b.box('entrance-light', (.10, 1.20, .045), (BACK+.06, 0, 1.995), 'lamp_soft', bevel=.006)
    # Door frame: pillars and a lintel around the opening; the ramp is lowered to the ground.
    for side in (-1, 1):
        b.box('door-pillar', (0.08, 0.5, 1.5), (BACK + 0.04, side * 1.0, 1.35), 'paint', bevel=0.02)
    b.box('lintel', (0.08, 1.6, 0.26), (BACK + 0.04, 0, TOP - 0.15), 'paint', bevel=0.02)
    rake = math.radians(24)
    ramp_len = 1.45
    hinge = Vector((BACK, 0, 0.65))
    centre = hinge + Vector((-math.cos(rake) * ramp_len / 2, 0, -math.sin(rake) * ramp_len / 2))
    b.box('ramp', (ramp_len, 1.5, 0.08), centre, 'paint', rot=(0, -rake, 0), bevel=0.02)
    treads = Batch(b, 'ramp-treads', 'gunmetal')
    for k in range(7):
        d = 0.15 + k * 0.19
        p = hinge + Vector((-math.cos(rake) * d, 0, -math.sin(rake) * d + 0.05))
        treads.box((0.04, 1.36, 0.03), p, (0, -rake, 0))
    treads.done()
    for side in (-1, 1):
        b.box('ramp-hinge', (0.12, 0.2, 0.12), (BACK, side * 0.55, 0.65), 'gunmetal', bevel=0.02)
        b.tube('ramp-cable', [(BACK + 0.02, side * 0.72, 1.9), (BACK - math.cos(rake) * 1.17, side * 0.72, .65 - math.sin(rake) * 1.17 + .04)], 0.012, 'cable', smooth=False)


def _rear_door(b):
    """Sealed rear ramp with inset personnel door, hinge pins, latches and jamb seals."""
    b.box('rear-seal',(.035,1.57,1.39),(BACK-.013,0,1.32),'rubber',bevel=.035)
    _panel(b,'rear-ramp',(BACK-.031,.755,.64),(0,-1,0),(0,0,1),(1.51,1.36))
    b.box('door-seal',(.02,.72,1.03),(BACK-.057,.25,1.35),'rubber',bevel=.036)
    b.box('personnel-door',(.026,.68,.99),(BACK-.073,.25,1.35),'paint_dark',bevel=.022)
    for z in (.91,1.71):
        b.box('door-hinge-leaf',(.038,.16,.065),(BACK-.099,.60,z),'paint',bevel=.007)
        b.cyl('door-hinge-pin',.021,.13,(BACK-.12,.66,z),'steel',verts=12,bevel=.003)
    b.tube('door-handle',[(BACK-.101,-.01,1.27),(BACK-.15,-.01,1.27),(BACK-.15,-.01,1.43),(BACK-.101,-.01,1.43)],.017,'gunmetal',smooth=False)
    for y in (-.60,.60):
        b.cyl('ramp-pivot',.048,.26,(BACK-.065,y,.67),'gunmetal',rot=(PI/2,0,0),verts=20,bevel=.006)
        b.box('ramp-lock',(.07,.12,.15),(BACK-.075,y,1.91),'paint_dark',bevel=.012)
    b.tube('rear-grab',[(BACK-.08,-.38,1.97),(BACK-.14,-.38,1.97),(BACK-.14,.37,1.97),(BACK-.08,.37,1.97)],.021,'paint_dark',smooth=False)


def _side(b, side, mission):
    """Fitted side plates, shallow upper stowage, tools, arch guards and exhaust."""
    s = side
    start,end=BACK+.12,ROOF_FRONT-.04
    u=(1,0,0) if s<0 else (-1,0,0)
    x=start if s<0 else end
    _panel(b,'sponson', (x,s*SPONSON,SPONSON_Z0+.025),u,(0,0,1),(end-start,.45),cols=7)
    up=Vector((0,s*(1.1-SPONSON),TOP-SPONSON_Z1))
    _panel(b,'shoulder', (x,s*SPONSON,SPONSON_Z1),u,up,(end-start,up.length-.04),cols=7)
    # Guards sit in the actual gaps between tyres, never cutting a tyre silhouette.
    for gx in (1.65,.075,-1.50,-2.92):
        b.wedge('arch-guard',[(-.22,1.365),(.22,1.365),(.09,1.105),(-.07,1.105)],.04,
                (gx,s*(SPONSON-.02),0),'paint_dark',bevel=.008)
        b.cyl('guard-bolt',.024,.02,(gx,s*(SPONSON+.009),1.29),'steel',rot=(PI/2,0,0),verts=6,bevel=0)
    for gx in (AXLES[1]-.66,AXLES[3]-.66):
        b.box('mudflap',(.022,.43,.36),(gx,s*TRACK,1.12),'rubber',bevel=.004)
        b.box('mudflap-clamp',(.045,.43,.04),(gx,s*TRACK,1.29),'gunmetal',bevel=.004)
    # All stowage sits above z=1.87: the side armour slot below stays clear.
    bx=-2.25
    y=s*1.31
    b.box('stowage-bin',(.70,.22,.29),(bx,y,2.045),'paint_dark',bevel=.025)
    b.box('bin-lid',(.67,.025,.25),(bx,s*1.432,2.048),'paint',bevel=.014)
    fittings=Batch(b,'bin-hardware','gunmetal')
    for dx in (-.25,.25):
        fittings.box((.06,.034,.075),(bx+dx,s*1.454,1.96))
        fittings.cyl(.022,.095,(bx+dx,s*1.453,2.172),(0,PI/2,0),verts=12)
    fittings.done()
    b.tube('bin-handle',[(bx-.10,s*1.451,2.06),(bx-.10,s*1.481,2.06),(bx+.10,s*1.481,2.06),(bx+.10,s*1.451,2.06)],.011,'steel',smooth=False)
    # Two small strapped fluid cans with caps and stamped X ribs.
    for j in range(2):
        cx=-3.04+j*.255
        b.box('jerrycan',(.21,.16,.34),(cx,s*1.34,2.06),'paint_dark',bevel=.023)
        b.box('can-strap',(.035,.018,.34),(cx,s*1.429,2.06),'canvas',bevel=.004)
        b.cyl('can-cap',.036,.018,(cx-.065,s*1.34,2.24),'gunmetal',verts=12,bevel=.002)
        b.tube('can-handle',[(cx-.03,s*1.32,2.226),(cx-.02,s*1.32,2.275),(cx+.07,s*1.32,2.275),(cx+.08,s*1.32,2.226)],.012,'paint',smooth=False)
        for direction in (-1,1):
            b.tube('can-stamping',[(cx-.073,s*1.424,2.06-direction*.115),(cx+.073,s*1.424,2.06+direction*.115)],.007,'paint',smooth=False)
    b.box('can-tray',(.52,.23,.035),(-2.91,s*1.34,1.875),'gunmetal',bevel=.008)
    b.box('can-retainer',(.51,.02,.038),(-2.91,s*1.46,1.98),'paint',bevel=.005)
    # Pioneer tools are restrained on the upper slope, clear of the armour panels.
    for z,cx,L in ((2.01,-.63,1.14),(2.16,-.60,.96)):
        b.cyl('tool-shaft',.018,L,(cx,s*1.29,z),'wood',rot=(0,PI/2,0),verts=12,bevel=.002)
        for xx in (cx-.31,cx+.29):
            b.box('tool-clamp',(.055,.08,.067),(xx,s*1.28,z),'gunmetal',bevel=.008)
    b.box('shovel-socket',(.16,.035,.05),(-.01,s*1.30,2.01),'steel',bevel=.009)
    b.wedge('shovel-blade',[(-.13,-.075),(.07,-.075),(.13,-.025),(.13,.05),(-.13,.05)],.035,(.13,s*1.3,2.01),'gunmetal',bevel=.012)
    b.box('pick-head',(.075,.055,.23),(-.08,s*1.29,2.15),'gunmetal',rot=(0,.27,0),bevel=.012)
    # Short folding ladder uses the centre axle gap; upper attachments remain inside the side slot plane.
    lx=.075
    for dx in (-.12,.12):
        b.tube('ladder-rail',[(lx+dx,s*1.36,.72),(lx+dx,s*1.385,1.30)],.017,'gunmetal',smooth=False)
    for z in (.76,.96,1.16):
        b.box('ladder-rung',(.28,.085,.025),(lx,s*1.385,z),'steel',bevel=.005)
    b.tube('boarding-handle',[(1.33,s*1.25,2.01),(1.33,s*1.34,2.06),(1.66,s*1.34,2.06),(1.66,s*1.25,2.01)],.015,'paint_dark',smooth=False)
    if s>0:
        _grille(b,'exhaust',(.83,1.242,2.06),(-1,0,0),(0,-.26,.44),(.66,.32))



def _cheeks(b):
    """Faceted cheek plates follow the immutable front stations; no expanded hull envelope."""
    for side in (-1,1):
        points=[(2.075,side*1.374,1.39),(2.925,side*1.316,1.385),
                (2.925,side*1.316,1.601),(2.075,side*1.374,1.851)]
        upper=[(2.075,side*1.373,1.865),(2.925,side*1.314,1.617),
               (2.925,side*1.070,1.755),(2.075,side*1.119,2.296)]
        for ring in (points,upper):
            bm=bmesh.new()
            outer=[bm.verts.new(p) for p in ring]
            inner=[bm.verts.new(Vector(p)-Vector((0,side*.014,0))) for p in ring]
            bm.faces.new(outer); bm.faces.new(inner[::-1])
            for k in range(4):
                bm.faces.new((outer[k],outer[(k+1)%4],inner[(k+1)%4],inner[k]))
            bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals(bm,faces=list(bm.faces))
            b._mesh('front-cheek',bm,'paint',(0,0,0),(0,0,0),.004,2,smooth=False)
        bolts=Batch(b,'cheek-bolts','gunmetal')
        for x,y,z in ((2.15,1.379,1.45),(2.82,1.333,1.45),(2.81,1.332,1.63),
                      (2.13,1.361,1.89),(2.15,1.166,2.19),(2.78,1.123,1.80)):
            bolts.cyl(.022,.018,(x,side*y,z),(PI/2,0,0),verts=6)
        bolts.done()


def _front(b, mission):
    """Glacis service panels, framed vision blocks, guarded lamps and forged towing eyes."""
    bottom=Vector((GLACIS_X,-.91,GLACIS_Z))
    up=Vector((ROOF_FRONT-GLACIS_X,0,TOP-GLACIS_Z))
    normal=Vector((up.z,0,-up.x)).normalized()
    rake=math.atan2(up.z,-up.x)
    glazed=mission in ('COMMAND','MINE')
    _panel(b,'glacis',bottom+up.normalized()*.045,(0,1,0),up,(1.82,up.length*(.34 if glazed else .87)),cols=2)
    for y in (-.47,.47):
        if glazed:
            c=Vector((GLACIS_X,y,GLACIS_Z))+up*.68
            b.box('windscreen-gasket',(.50,.85,.055),c+normal*.023,'rubber',rot=(0,rake,0),bevel=.025)
            b.box('windscreen-glass',(.44,.75,.020),c+normal*.057,'glass',rot=(0,rake,0),bevel=.015)
            # Armour rails frame the glass instead of covering it with a single slab.
            for dy in (-.412,.412):
                b.box('window-rail',(.51,.045,.045),c+Vector((0,dy,0))+normal*.052,'paint',rot=(0,rake,0),bevel=.007)
            for t in (-.244,.244):
                pos=c+up.normalized()*t+normal*.052
                b.box('window-rail',(.045,.85,.045),pos,'paint',rot=(0,rake,0),bevel=.007)
            a=c-up.normalized()*.19+Vector((0,-.27,0))+normal*.08
            z=c+up.normalized()*.04+Vector((0,.12,0))+normal*.08
            b.tube('wiper-arm',[a,z],.012,'black',smooth=False)
            b.tube('wiper-blade',[z+Vector((0,-.20,0)),z+Vector((0,.16,0))],.014,'rubber',smooth=False)
        else:
            c=Vector((2.25,y,TOP-(2.25-ROOF_FRONT)*(TOP-GLACIS_Z)/(GLACIS_X-ROOF_FRONT)))
            b.box('vision-hood',(.24,.42,.12),c+normal*.074,'paint_dark',rot=(0,rake,0),bevel=.024)
            b.box('vision-glass',(.027,.32,.063),c+normal*.083+Vector((.119,0,-.061)),'glass',rot=(0,rake,0),bevel=.008)
        b.tube('glacis-grab',[(2.72,y-.13,1.91),(2.72,y-.13,1.99),(2.72,y+.13,1.99),(2.72,y+.13,1.91)],.018,'paint_dark',smooth=False)
    nose_up=Vector((GLACIS_X-FRONT,0,GLACIS_Z-1.48))
    _panel(b,'nose-deck',(FRONT-.025,-.82,1.495),(0,1,0),nose_up,(1.64,.51),cols=2)
    for y in (-.70,.70):
        b.cyl('nose-hinge',.024,.20,(3.29,y,1.602),'gunmetal',rot=(PI/2,0,0),verts=12,bevel=.003)
    _panel(b,'nose', (FRONT+.001,-.73,1.08),(0,1,0),(0,0,1),(1.46,.32),cols=3)
    for y in (-.62,.62):
        b.box('tow-clevis',(.13,.19,.14),(FRONT+.015,y,1.19),'paint_dark',bevel=.018)
        b.cyl('tow-pin',.044,.24,(FRONT+.09,y,1.18),'gunmetal',rot=(PI/2,0,0),verts=16,bevel=.004)
        pts=[(FRONT+.12,y+.095*math.sin(a),1.065+.13*math.cos(a)) for a in [2*PI*k/16 for k in range(17)]]
        b.tube('tow-shackle',pts,.027,'steel',smooth=False)
    for side in (-1,1):
        at=Vector((GLACIS_X+.03,side*1.095,1.64))
        b.box('headlight-housing',(.25,.38,.24),at,'paint_dark',bevel=.025)
        b.box('headlight-inset',(.018,.335,.19),at+Vector((.13,0,0)),'black',bevel=.013)
        for dy,r,mat in ((-side*.075,.063,'lamp'),(side*.098,.041,'amber')):
            b.cyl('lamp-bezel',r+.012,.036,at+Vector((.143,dy,0)),'gunmetal',rot=(0,PI/2,0),verts=24,bevel=.003)
            b.cyl('lamp-lens',r,.014,at+Vector((.166,dy,0)),mat,rot=(0,PI/2,0),verts=24,bevel=.003)
        cage=Batch(b,'headlight-cage','paint_dark')
        for z in (-.12,-.04,.04,.12):
            cage.box((.016,.405,.016),at+Vector((.203,0,z)))
        for yy in (-.20,-.066,.066,.20):
            cage.box((.016,.016,.25),at+Vector((.203,yy,0)))
        for yy in (-.20,.20):
            cage.box((.22,.018,.018),at+Vector((.1,yy,.12)))
        cage.done(bevel=.004)
        arm=Vector((2.19,side*1.21,2.065))
        b.box('mirror-foot',(.14,.07,.10),arm,'paint_dark',bevel=.009)
        b.tube('mirror-arm',[arm,arm+Vector((.08,side*.23,.07)),arm+Vector((.08,side*.25,.41))],.018,'gunmetal',smooth=False)
        c=arm+Vector((.08,side*.25,.49))
        b.box('mirror-shell',(.065,.18,.29),c,'rubber',bevel=.022)
        b.box('mirror-face',(.012,.148,.252),c+Vector((-.037,0,0)),'glass',bevel=.014)


def _roof(b, mission):
    """Low-profile deck service hatches and vents; all mission equipment remains separate."""
    _grille(b,'engine-deck',(1.40,.62,TOP+.002),(1,0,0),(0,1,0),(.90,.70))
    _panel(b,'engine-access',(.22,.27,TOP),(1,0,0),(0,1,0),(.63,.70))
    # Deck centre and edges have only flush seams; no smoke tubes or equipment racks.
    seams=Batch(b,'deck-seams','paint_dark')
    for x in (-2.15,-1.0,.25):
        seams.box((.008,1.99,.003),(x,0,TOP+.001))
    seams.done()
    if mission not in ('COMMAND','MINE'):
        b.cyl('driver-hatch-gasket',.295,.018,(1.56,-.56,TOP+.009),'rubber',verts=48,bevel=0)
        b.cyl('driver-hatch',.278,.025,(1.56,-.56,TOP+.028),'paint',verts=48,bevel=.008)
        b.cyl('hatch-hinge',.027,.22,(1.285,-.56,TOP+.04),'gunmetal',rot=(PI/2,0,0),verts=12,bevel=.003)
        b.tube('hatch-grab',[(1.62,-.66,TOP+.043),(1.62,-.66,TOP+.09),(1.62,-.46,TOP+.09),(1.62,-.46,TOP+.043)],.012,'paint_dark',smooth=False)
    for y in (-.51,.51):
        _panel(b,'rear-service',(-3.02,y-.39,TOP),(1,0,0),(0,1,0),(.78,.78))
        for dx in (-2.93,-2.47):
            b.cyl('service-hinge',.018,.12,(dx,y+.37,TOP+.028),'gunmetal',rot=(0,PI/2,0),verts=12,bevel=.003)
        b.box('service-latch',(.1,.035,.018),(-2.63,y-.32,TOP+.032),'gunmetal',bevel=.004)
    for side in (-1,1):
        at=Vector((BACK-.031,side*1.13,1.58))
        b.box('tail-housing',(.08,.32,.18),at,'paint_dark',bevel=.016)
        b.box('tail-recess',(.014,.275,.126),at+Vector((-.045,0,0)),'black',bevel=.006)
        for dy,mat in ((-.09,'amber'),(0,'red'),(.09,'lamp')):
            b.box('tail-lens',(.02,.072,.085),at+Vector((-.057,dy,0)),mat,bevel=.007)
        _grille(b,'rear-vent',(BACK-.02,side*1.13,1.95),(0,-1,0),(0,0,1),(.30,.34))
        b.box('rear-tow-lug',(.12,.16,.12),(BACK-.03,side*.68,.88),'paint_dark',bevel=.012)
        b.cyl('rear-tow-pin',.035,.19,(BACK-.10,side*.68,.89),'gunmetal',rot=(PI/2,0,0),verts=12,bevel=.004)
        b.tube('rear-shackle',[(BACK-.13,side*.68+.065*math.sin(a),.79+.10*math.cos(a)) for a in [2*PI*k/14 for k in range(15)]],.023,'steel',smooth=False)
    b.box('tow-crossmember',(.16,1.36,.12),(BACK+.01,0,.65),'gunmetal',bevel=.02)
    b.box('pintle-mount',(.12,.23,.17),(BACK-.09,0,.82),'paint_dark',bevel=.014)
    b.tube('pintle',[(BACK-.13,0,.88),(BACK-.26,0,.77),(BACK-.29,0,.86)],.038,'gunmetal',smooth=False)


def _running_gear(b):
    for i, x in enumerate(AXLES):
        b.cyl('axle', 0.08, TRACK * 2 - 0.5, (x, 0, R), 'gunmetal', rot=(PI / 2, 0, 0), verts=16)
        b.sphere('diff', 0.18, (x, 0, R), 'gunmetal', scale=(1, 0.8, 0.9))
        for s in (-1, 1):
            _wheel(b, f'wheel{i}{s:+d}', (x, s * TRACK, R), s)
            b.box('lower-arm', (0.12, 0.42, 0.08), (x - 0.1, s * 0.72, R - 0.12), 'gunmetal', bevel=0.02)
            b.cyl('damper', 0.05, 0.6, (x - 0.22, s * 0.78, R + 0.32), 'steel', rot=(s * 0.25, 0, 0), verts=12)
    b.box('driveline', (AXLES[0] - AXLES[3], 0.12, 0.12), ((AXLES[0] + AXLES[3]) / 2, 0, R + 0.05), 'gunmetal', bevel=0.02)


def _crane(b):
    """Rear-facing telescopic recovery crane with pinned cheeks, lift ram, winch and hanging hook."""
    pivot=Vector((BACK+.70,0,TOP+.73))
    b.cyl('crane-slew',.49,.13,(pivot.x,0,TOP+.065),'gunmetal',verts=48,bevel=.015)
    b.cyl('crane-pedestal',.37,.22,(pivot.x,0,TOP+.22),'paint_dark',verts=32,bevel=.016)
    bolts=Batch(b,'slew-bolts','steel')
    for k in range(16):
        a=2*PI*k/16
        bolts.cyl(.023,.025,(pivot.x+.43*math.cos(a),.43*math.sin(a),TOP+.143),verts=6)
    bolts.done()
    for side in (-1,1):
        b.wedge('crane-cheek',[(-.45,-.48),(.40,-.48),(.30,.19),(-.17,.31),(-.41,.08)],.095,
                pivot+Vector((0,side*.31,0)),'paint',bevel=.022)
        b.cyl('boom-pivot',.095,.12,pivot+Vector((0,side*.34,0)),'gunmetal',rot=(PI/2,0,0),verts=24,bevel=.008)
        b.cyl('pivot-cap',.065,.02,pivot+Vector((0,side*.412,0)),'steel',rot=(PI/2,0,0),verts=12,bevel=.003)
    angle=math.radians(17)
    d=Vector((-math.cos(angle),0,math.sin(angle)))
    length=2.18
    rot=(0,angle,0)
    b.box('crane-boom',(length,.39,.40),pivot+d*(length/2-.10),'paint',rot=rot,bevel=.025)
    tip=pivot+d*3.08
    b.box('telescopic-stage',(1.40,.285,.285),pivot+d*2.43,'paint_dark',rot=rot,bevel=.018)
    b.box('boom-end-collar',(.16,.455,.46),pivot+d*1.98,'gunmetal',rot=rot,bevel=.012)
    b.box('boom-end-sleeve',(.11,.415,.42),pivot+d*2.055,'paint',rot=rot,bevel=.012)
    for side in (-1,1):
        for along in (.35,1.60):
            b.box('boom-service-cover',(.36,.028,.25),pivot+d*along+Vector((0,side*.21,0)),'paint_dark',rot=rot,bevel=.01)
            for dx in (-.13,.13):
                b.cyl('boom-cover-bolt',.019,.018,pivot+d*(along+dx)+Vector((0,side*.234,0)),'steel',rot=(PI/2,0,0),verts=6,bevel=0)
    low=pivot+Vector((.12,0,-.41)); high=pivot+d*1.38+Vector((0,0,-.23))
    delta=high-low
    b.tube('lift-cylinder',[low,low+delta*.65],.087,'paint_dark',smooth=False)
    b.tube('lift-piston',[low+delta*.57,high],.044,'chrome',smooth=False)
    for endpoint in (low,high):
        b.cyl('ram-pin',.065,.29,endpoint,'gunmetal',rot=(PI/2,0,0),verts=16,bevel=.006)
    for side in (-1,1):
        b.tube('hydraulic-hose',[pivot+Vector((.22,side*.25,-.38)),pivot+Vector((.42,side*.25,-.13)),
                               pivot+d*.45+Vector((0,side*.235,.23)),pivot+d*1.80+Vector((0,side*.235,.23))],.015,'cable')
        b.box('sheave-cheek',(.28,.04,.33),tip+Vector((0,side*.17,0)),'paint',rot=rot,bevel=.02)
    b.cyl('tip-sheave',.125,.27,tip,'gunmetal',rot=(PI/2,0,0),verts=32,bevel=.008)
    # Drum behind the pivot, cable routed across the boom to the sheave.
    drum=pivot+Vector((.34,0,-.19))
    b.cyl('winch-drum',.15,.41,drum,'gunmetal',rot=(PI/2,0,0),verts=32,bevel=.01)
    winding=Batch(b,'winch-winding','cable')
    for k in range(13):

    b.tube('hook-latch',[hook+Vector((-.20,0,-.23)),hook+Vector((0,0,-.19))],.009,'gunmetal',smooth=False)
    # Rear stabiliser remains clear of the ground and rear door.
    b.box('stabiliser-blade',(.12,2.10,.40),(BACK-.23,0,.53),'paint_dark',rot=(0,.20,0),bevel=.025)
    b.box('spade-cutting-edge',(.14,2.16,.065),(BACK-.19,0,.34),'steel',bevel=.008)

        b.tube('spade-cylinder',[(BACK+.03,y,1.03),(BACK-.20,y,.66)],.065,'paint_dark',smooth=False)
        b.tube('spade-piston',[(BACK-.12,y,.76),(BACK-.25,y,.53)],.035,'steel',smooth=False)



def _mounts(mission, top=TOP):
    roof_x = -0.3
    deck_x = BACK + 1.25
    deck_length = 2.0
    rear_sensor_x, rear_sensor_y = BACK + 2.4, 1.05
    if mission == 'RECOVERY':
        # Reserve the rear crane circle, then cabin, then the full-size weapon ring.
        deck_x, deck_length, roof_x = -1.55, 1.4, .15
        rear_sensor_x, rear_sensor_y = -2.15, 1.18
    if mission == 'TROOP':
        roof_x = 0.0
    return Mounts(
        front=FRONT + 0.05, back=BACK, axles=AXLES, wheel_r=R, track=TRACK, tyre_w=TYRE_W,
        deck=(deck_x, top), deck_size=(deck_length, 2.1),
        roof=(roof_x, 0.0, top), roof2=(ROOF_FRONT - (0.77 if mission == 'RECOVERY' else 0.95), -0.45, top),
        side=(BACK + 0.4, ROOF_FRONT - 0.1, SPONSON_Z0 + 0.04, SPONSON_Z1, SPONSON + 0.04),
        front_face=(GLACIS_X + 0.2, 1.05, GLACIS_Z - 0.05, 1.05),
        roof_span=(BACK + 0.2, ROOF_FRONT - 0.05, top, 1.15), belly=(BACK + 0.4, GLACIS_X, 0.52, 0.75),
        engine=(1.38, 0.62, top), tanks=(BACK + 0.08, BACK + 0.64, 0.95, 1.0),
        antenna_left=(BACK + 0.45, -1.0, top), antenna_right=(BACK + 0.45, 1.0, top), radio_mast=(BACK + 0.35, 0.75, top),
        optics=(ROOF_FRONT - 0.25, -0.85, top), sensor_mast=(ROOF_FRONT - 0.7, 0.97, top),
        corners=((ROOF_FRONT - 0.1, -1.05, top), (ROOF_FRONT - 0.1, 1.05, top), (rear_sensor_x, -rear_sensor_y, top), (rear_sensor_x, rear_sensor_y, top)),
        bumper=(FRONT + 0.05, 1.15), hitch=(BACK - 0.1, 0.82), rack=(BACK + 2.75, 0.0, top),
        extra={'armoured': True, 'module_h': 1.15},
    )


def build(mats, mission):
    b = Builder('base', mats)
    _hull(b, mission)
    for side in (-1, 1):
        _side(b, side, mission)
    _cheeks(b)
    _front(b, mission)
    _roof(b, mission)
    _running_gear(b)
    if mission == 'RECOVERY':
        _crane(b)
    if mission == 'COMBAT':
        b.revolve('turret-mount-flange', [(.87, -.014), (.95, -.014), (.95, .014), (.87, .014)], (-.3, 0, TOP), 'gunmetal', rot=(PI/2,0,0), steps=64)
    return _mounts(mission)
```
