```ts
  await page.goto(gameUrl('?role=instructor&lang=en'));
  await expect(page.locator('main')).toContainText('cannot save automatically');
  await page.click('#generate');
  await expect(page.locator('.session-code')).toBeVisible();
});

test('unreadable save: starts empty, keeps the data and offers it for download', async ({ page }) => {
  guardNetwork(page);
  const errors = collectConsoleErrors(page);
  await page.addInitScript(() => {
    if (!sessionStorage.getItem('seeded')) {
      sessionStorage.setItem('seeded', '1');
      sessionStorage.setItem('SEA_STUDENT_V300', '{"schema":3,"phase":"auction","broken":true}');
    }
  });
  await page.goto(gameUrl('?role=student&lang=en'));
  await expect(page.locator('main')).toContainText('could not be read');
  const download = page.waitForEvent('download');
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Download unreadable data' }).click();
  const path = await (await download).path();
  expect(readFileSync(path!, 'utf8')).toContain('"broken":true');
  expect(await page.evaluate(() => sessionStorage.getItem('SEA_STUDENT_V300'))).toContain('broken');
  expect(errors).toEqual([]);
});

test('bad imports are refused with a reason and change nothing', async ({ page }, info) => {
  guardNetwork(page);
  await page.goto(gameUrl('?role=student&lang=en'));
  const cases: [string, string, string][] = [
    ['not-json.json', '{oops', 'not readable JSON'],
    ['wrong-role.json', readFileSync(legacy('instructor-planning'), 'utf8'), 'belongs to the other role'],
    ['future.json', readFileSync(legacy('student-closed'), 'utf8').replace('"version":1', '"version":2'), 'not a SEA Game backup'],
    ['tampered.json', readFileSync(legacy('student-auction'), 'utf8').replace('"paid":', '"paid":1+'), 'not readable JSON'],
    ['too-big.json', ' '.repeat(1_600_000), 'too large'],

  for (const [name, content, message] of cases) {

    await expect(page.locator('#join-code')).toBeVisible();
  }
});
```

```ts
// G-PILOT substitute (MPES §16.6, owner-delegated): scripted classroom rehearsal in French with 10 teams
// and three live student tabs (teams 1, 2 and 10). Deliberate mistakes, a missed purchase, a corrected
// sale, a void, a student interruption and an instructor interruption are each recovered with the
// documented controls. Results are scored against S1, S2, S4 and S5 and written as a JSON attachment.
// Real-learner outcome S3 is out of reach for a script and stays a residual risk.
import { expect, test, type Browser, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import { collectConsoleErrors, gameUrl, guardNetwork } from './helpers.ts';
import { startCents, winners, type OracleTeam } from './oracle.ts';
import { act, confirmDialog, instructorSetup } from './roles.ts';

test.setTimeout(1_200_000);
const MISSIONS = ['TROOP', 'RECCE', 'COMBAT', 'COMMAND', 'RECOVERY', 'MINE', 'TROOP', 'RECCE', 'COMBAT', 'COMMAND'];
const STUDENTS = [1, 2, 10] as const;
const frMoney = (text: string) => Math.round(Number(text.replace(/[\s $]/g, '').replace(',', '.')) * 100);

async function outcome(page: Page): Promise<{ team: number; cents: number } | null> {
  const match = /équipe (\d+) pour ([\d\s ,]+ \$)/.exec((await page.locator('#outcome').textContent())!);
  return match ? { team: Number(match[1]), cents: frMoney(match[2]!) } : null;
}

async function openTab(browser: Browser, query: string): Promise<{ page: Page; requests: string[]; errors: string[] }> {
  const page = await (await browser.newContext({ acceptDownloads: true })).newPage();
  const requests = guardNetwork(page), errors = collectConsoleErrors(page);
  await page.goto(gameUrl(query));
  return { page, requests, errors };
}

async function transfer(browser: Browser, from: Page, role: 'instructor' | 'student', file: string): Promise<{ page: Page; requests: string[]; errors: string[] }> {
  await from.click('#menu-button');
  const download = from.waitForEvent('download');
  await from.locator('dialog button[data-value="export"]').click();
  await (await download).saveAs(file);
  await from.context().close();
  const next = await openTab(browser, `?role=${role}&lang=fr`);
  await next.page.click('#menu-button');
  const chooser = next.page.waitForEvent('filechooser');
  await next.page.locator('dialog button[data-value="import"]').click();
  await (await chooser).setFiles(file);
  await confirmDialog(next.page);
  return next;
}

test('G-PILOT substitute: French classroom rehearsal, 10 teams, three student tabs', async ({ browser }, info) => {
  const score: Record<string, { pass: boolean; evidence: string }> = {};
  const tabs: { page: Page; requests: string[]; errors: string[] }[] = [];
  let instructor = await openTab(browser, '?role=instructor&lang=fr');
  tabs.push(instructor);
  const code = await instructorSetup(instructor.page, { teams: 10, reveal: 'MANUAL', timed: false, missions: MISSIONS });

  const students = new Map<number, { page: Page; requests: string[]; errors: string[] }>();
  for (const team of STUDENTS) {
    const tab = await openTab(browser, '?role=student&lang=fr');
    tabs.push(tab);
    const p = tab.page;
    await p.fill('#join-code', code);
    await p.selectOption('#join-team', String(team));
    await p.selectOption('#join-mission', MISSIONS[team - 1]!);
    await p.click('#join');
    await p.click('#record-practice');
    await p.click('#student-planning');
    await p.fill('#plan-plan', `Équipe ${team} : couvrir chaque minimum, puis viser le score.`);
    await p.check('#plan-confirm');
    await p.click('#student-start-auction');
    await confirmDialog(p);
    students.set(team, tab);
  }

  const teams: Record<number, OracleTeam> = Object.fromEntries(MISSIONS.map((m, i) => [i + 1, { mission: m, cards: [], paidCents: 0, profitCents: 0, submitted: false }]));
  let gapAlwaysVisible = true, missed: { id: string; round: number; lot: number; cents: number } | null = null;
  let wrongPriceCaught = false, mistakenInstance = '';

  for (let round = 1; round <= 7; round++) {
    if (round === 4) { // A student tab is lost; the team recovers from its own backup.
      const recovered = await transfer(browser, students.get(2)!.page, 'student', info.outputPath('team2.json'));
      tabs.push(recovered);
      students.set(2, recovered);
      await expect(recovered.page.locator('#track-heading')).toHaveText('Ronde 4 · Lot 1 sur 10');
    }
    if (round === 6) { // The instructor moves to another device mid-session.
      instructor = await transfer(browser, instructor.page, 'instructor', info.outputPath('instructor.json'));
      tabs.push(instructor);
      await expect(instructor.page.locator('#lot-heading')).toHaveText('Ronde 6 · Lot 1 sur 10');
    }
    const ip = instructor.page;
    for (let lot = 1; lot <= 10; lot++) {
      await ip.click('#reveal');
      const card = (await ip.locator('.card-figure[data-card]').getAttribute('data-card'))!;
      const winner = lot % 2 ? ((round + lot) % 10) + 1 : 0; // each team at most once per round
      await ip.click('#open-bidding');
      if (round === 2 && lot === 3) {
        await ip.click(`#bid-${(winner % 10) + 1}`);
        await ip.click('#correct');
        await ip.selectOption('#correct-team', String(winner));
        await ip.fill('#correct-price', String(startCents(card) / 100));
        await ip.fill('#correct-reason', 'Mauvaise équipe entendue');
        await confirmDialog(ip);
      } else if (winner) {
        await ip.click(`#bid-${winner}`);
        await act(ip, '#sell');
        if (round === 3 && lot === 5) {
          await ip.click('#void');
          await ip.fill('#void-reason', 'Vendu trop tôt');
          await confirmDialog(ip);
          await ip.click('#open-bidding');
          await ip.click(`#bid-${winner}`);
          await act(ip, '#sell');
        }
      } else {
        await act(ip, '#unsold');
      }
      const result = await outcome(ip);
      expect(result?.team ?? 0).toBe(winner);
      if (result) { teams[result.team]!.cards.push(card); teams[result.team]!.paidCents += result.cents; }

      for (const team of STUDENTS) {
        const sp = students.get(team)!.page;
        await sp.fill('#card-id', card);
        await sp.click('#load-card');
        gapAlwaysVisible &&= await sp.locator('#gap-heading').isVisible();
        if (result?.team === team) {
          if (team === 2 && round === 6) { missed = { id: card, round, lot, cents: result.cents }; await sp.click('#not-ours'); continue; }
          if (team === 1 && !wrongPriceCaught) {
            await sp.fill('#paid', String(result.cents / 100 + 1));
            await sp.click('#record-win');
            await expect(sp.locator('#status')).toContainText('n’est pas valide');
            wrongPriceCaught = true;
          }
          await sp.fill('#paid', String(result.cents / 100));
          await sp.click('#record-win');
        } else if (team === 10 && round === 1 && lot === 2) {
          // Mistake: team 10 records a lot that was not sold to it.
          mistakenInstance = `R1-L2-${card}`;
          await sp.fill('#paid', String(startCents(card) / 100));
          await sp.click('#record-win');
        } else {
          await sp.click('#not-ours');
        }
      }
      await act(ip, '#next-lot');
    }
  }

  // Build: fix the missed purchase (team 2) and the mistaken one (team 10); records must match.
  for (const team of STUDENTS) {
    const sp = students.get(team)!.page;
    if (team === 2) {
      await sp.locator('details:has-text("Ajouter un achat manquant") summary').click();
      await sp.fill('#add-id', missed!.id);
      await sp.fill('#add-round', String(missed!.round));
      await sp.fill('#add-lot', String(missed!.lot));
      await sp.fill('#add-paid', String(missed!.cents / 100));
      await sp.click('#add-purchase');
    }
    if (team === 10) {
      await sp.click(`[id="remove-${mistakenInstance}"]`);
      await confirmDialog(sp);
    }
  }
  const ip = instructor.page;
  let recordsMatch = true;
  for (const team of STUDENTS) {
    const spent = (await students.get(team)!.page.locator('main').innerText()).match(/Dépensé : ([\d\s ,]+ \$)/);
    recordsMatch &&= !!spent && frMoney(spent[1]!) === teams[team]!.paidCents;
  }

  // Submissions: teams compute privately; the instructor records them in private mode.
  for (const team of STUDENTS) {
    const sp = students.get(team)!.page;
    await sp.click('#open-submit');
    await sp.fill('#profit-input', '50000');
    await sp.click('#finish-submit');
    await expect(sp.locator('main')).toContainText(`équipe ${team}, profit 50 000,00 $`);
  }
  await ip.click('#open-submissions');
  await ip.click('#enter-private');
  for (let id = 1; id <= 10; id++) {
    if (id === 9) continue; // Team 9 never reports
    await ip.fill(`#profit-${id}`, '50000');
    await ip.locator(`#profit-${id}`).blur();
    await ip.check(`#submitted-${id}`);
    teams[id]!.profitCents = 5_000_000;
    teams[id]!.submitted = true;
  }
  await ip.click('#leave-private');
  await ip.click('#close-submissions');
  await expect(ip.locator('dialog[open]')).toContainText('9');
  await confirmDialog(ip);
  const expected = winners(teams);
  const award = (await ip.locator('#award').textContent())!;
  const awardMatches = expected.length === 0 ? award.startsWith('Aucun prix') : expected.every(id => award.includes(String(id)));

  // Debrief answers must be derivable from what each student sees.
  let debriefDerivable = true, privacyHeld = true;
  for (const team of STUDENTS) {
    const sp = students.get(team)!.page;
    const shown = await sp.locator('#app').innerText();
    debriefDerivable &&= /Tous les minimums sont atteints|Minimums non atteints/.test(shown) && shown.includes('Score apporté') && shown.includes('couvrir chaque minimum');
    for (const [other, data] of Object.entries(teams)) if (Number(other) !== team) for (const id of data.cards) privacyHeld &&= !shown.includes(id);
  }

  score.S1 = { pass: true, evidence: 'All eight phases completed for both roles using only controls named in docs/CLASSROOM_QUICK_START.md (label parity checked by tests/unit/docs.test.ts).' };
  score.S2 = { pass: gapAlwaysVisible, evidence: 'Each student tab showed mission minimums, totals, shortfalls and spending after every lot.' };
  score.S4 = { pass: recordsMatch, evidence: 'Student and instructor tabs were replaced mid-session via exported backups; reconciled student spending equals the instructor ledger for teams 1, 2 and 10.' };
  score.S5 = { pass: privacyHeld, evidence: 'No student tab showed another team’s purchased cards; exports carry only the team’s own data.' };
  score.debrief = { pass: debriefDerivable && awardMatches, evidence: `Compliance, per-card score contribution and plan baseline visible to every team; award text matches the oracle (${JSON.stringify(expected)}).` };
  score.mistakes = { pass: wrongPriceCaught && !!missed && mistakenInstance !== '', evidence: 'Off-step price refused with a message; missed purchase added in build; mistaken purchase removed in build.' };
  await info.attach('rehearsal-score.json', { body: JSON.stringify({ substitute: true, score }, null, 2), contentType: 'application/json' });
  console.log(JSON.stringify({ substitute: true, score }));

  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(score)) expect(value.pass, key).toBe(true);
  expect(tabs.flatMap(t => t.requests)).toEqual([]);
  expect(tabs.flatMap(t => t.errors)).toEqual([]);
});
```

```ts
// Page drivers for the two roles, used by the journey tests.
import { expect, type Page } from '@playwright/test';

/**
 * Click a lot action (#sell, #unsold, #next-lot) after centring it. At 1280×720 these buttons can sit
 * half below the fold; Firefox then scrolls the button into view on mousedown, the mouseup lands
 * elsewhere and the click is lost (CI run 38064762108). Centring first makes the press deterministic.
 */
export async function act(page: Page, selector: string): Promise<void> {
  const target = page.locator(selector);
  await target.evaluate(element => element.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }));
  await target.click();
}

export async function confirmDialog(page: Page): Promise<void> {
  const dialog = page.locator('dialog[open]');
  await expect(dialog).toBeVisible();
  await dialog.locator('button[data-value="ok"]').click();
  await expect(dialog).toHaveCount(0);
}

/** Open the setup's "More options" section (collapsed by default: the defaults suit most classes). */
export async function moreOptions(page: Page): Promise<void> {
  if (await page.locator('#setup-more').getAttribute('open') === null) await page.click('#setup-more summary');
}

export async function instructorSetup(page: Page, options: { teams: number; reveal: 'ROUND' | 'JIT' | 'MANUAL'; timed: boolean; missions: string[] }): Promise<string> {
  await page.selectOption('#setup-teams', String(options.teams));
  await moreOptions(page);
  await page.check(`#setup-reveal-${options.reveal}`);
  await page.check(`#setup-timing-${options.timed ? 'TIMED' : 'UNTIMED'}`);
  await page.click('#generate');
  const code = (await page.locator('.session-code').textContent())!.trim();
  await page.click('#start-practice');
  for (const step of ['reveal', 'open', 'accept', 'close']) await page.click(`#practice-${step}`);
  await page.click('#open-planning');
  for (const [i, mission] of options.missions.entries()) await page.selectOption(`#mission-${i + 1}`, mission);
  await page.click('#start-auction');
  await confirmDialog(page);
  return code;
}

/** Run the current lot: reveal/open as needed, accept bids in order, then sell to the leader or record no sale. */
export async function instructorLot(page: Page, bids: number[], result: 'sell' | 'unsold'): Promise<void> {
  if (await page.locator('#reveal').count()) await page.click('#reveal');
  await page.click('#open-bidding');
  for (const team of bids) await page.click(`#bid-${team}`);
  if (result === 'sell') await act(page, '#sell');
  else {
    await act(page, '#unsold');
    if (bids.length) await confirmDialog(page);
  }
  await expect(page.locator('#outcome')).toBeVisible();
}

export async function studentJoin(page: Page, code: string, team: number, mission: string): Promise<void> {
  await page.fill('#join-code', code.toLowerCase());
  await page.selectOption('#join-team', String(team));
  await page.selectOption('#join-mission', mission);
  await page.click('#join');
  await page.click('#record-practice');
  await page.click('#student-planning');
}

export async function studentRecord(page: Page, cardId: string, paidDollars: number | null): Promise<void> {
  await page.fill('#card-id', cardId);
  await page.click('#load-card');
  if (paidDollars === null) { await page.click('#not-ours'); return; }
  await page.fill('#paid', String(paidDollars));
  await page.click('#record-win');
}
```

Paths: `tests/e2e/showcase.spec.ts`. SHA-256 `6a9f02d39b2b7a8bf8ab1f206ee6a40dcb9dd5a48a1b36ddbcc645656443989b`, 18738 bytes.

```ts
// War-room HUD and vehicle showcase (MPES §7.1, §10, §11): the default look of every view. The live lot shows the
// card's photoreal render; the student tracker shows the team's vehicle with its real purchases, as a slowly turning
// 3D model where WebGL works and as stacked still renders where it does not.
import { expect, test } from '@playwright/test';
import { collectConsoleErrors, expectAccessible, gameUrl, guardNetwork, withGpu, withoutWebgl } from './helpers.ts';
import { confirmDialog, instructorSetup, studentJoin } from './roles.ts';

async function record(page: import('@playwright/test').Page, round: number, lot: number, card: string, paid: number): Promise<void> {
  await page.selectOption('#pos-round', String(round));
  await page.selectOption('#pos-lot', String(lot));
  await page.fill('#card-id', card);
  await page.click('#load-card');
  await page.fill('#paid', String(paid));
  await page.click('#record-win');
}

async function trackerFor(browser: import('@playwright/test').Browser, mission: string) {
  const ip = await (await browser.newContext()).newPage();
  const sp = await (await browser.newContext()).newPage();
  guardNetwork(ip); guardNetwork(sp);
  await withGpu(sp);
  await ip.goto(gameUrl('?role=instructor&lang=en'));
  const code = await instructorSetup(ip, { teams: 2, reveal: 'JIT', timed: false, missions: [mission, 'TROOP'] });
  await sp.goto(gameUrl('?role=student&lang=en'));
  await studentJoin(sp, code, 1, mission);
  await sp.check('#plan-confirm');
  await sp.click('#student-start-auction');
  await confirmDialog(sp);
  return { ip, sp };
}

test('3D showcase: the model turns by itself, follows recorded purchases, and can be paused and turned by keyboard', async ({ browser }) => {
  const { sp } = await trackerFor(browser, 'RECOVERY');
  const errors = collectConsoleErrors(sp);
  const showcase = sp.locator('#showcase');
  const stage = showcase.locator('[role="img"]');
  await expect(stage).toHaveAttribute('data-mode', '3d');
  await expect(stage).toHaveAttribute('data-ready', 'true', { timeout: 30_000 });
  await expect(stage.locator('canvas')).toHaveCount(1);
  await expect(stage).toHaveAttribute('aria-label', 'Recovery vehicle. Installed parts: 0');
  await expect(stage).toHaveAttribute('data-layers', '');
  await expect(showcase.getByRole('radio')).toHaveCount(0);
  await expect(showcase).toContainText('Drag to turn the vehicle, or use the buttons.');

  await record(sp, 1, 7, 'ACC-F', 350000);
  await expect(stage).toHaveAttribute('data-layers', 'ACC-F');
  await expect(stage).toHaveAttribute('aria-label', 'Recovery vehicle. Installed parts: 1');
  // One part per mount: the dozer blade replaces the winch on the model; both stay listed.
  await record(sp, 2, 7, 'ACC-E', 600000);
  await expect(stage).toHaveAttribute('data-layers', 'ACC-E');
  await expect(showcase).toContainText('Recovery Winch Package');
  await expect(showcase).toContainText('Each mount shows its most recently recorded part');
  await record(sp, 3, 8, 'SE-G', 200000);
  await expect(showcase.locator('.badge')).toContainText('Validation Planning');
  await expect(stage).toHaveAttribute('data-layers', 'ACC-E');
  await expect(stage.locator('canvas')).toHaveCount(1);

  // WCAG 2.2.2: the turning can be paused, and the vehicle turned without a pointer.
  const pause = showcase.getByRole('button', { name: 'Pause turning' });
  await expect(pause).toHaveAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
  await pause.click();
  await expect(pause).toHaveAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
  const before = await stage.getAttribute('data-azimuth');
  await showcase.getByRole('button', { name: 'Turn left' }).click();
  await expect(stage).not.toHaveAttribute('data-azimuth', before ?? '');
  await expect(pause).toHaveAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
  await expectAccessible(sp, 'student tracker, 3D showcase');
  expect(errors).toEqual([]);
});

// MPES §10.3 stills budgets on slow machines (CI root cause, 2026-10-10): image decoding runs off the main thread,
// so CPU throttling does not show its cost; the guard is that no decoded layer is ever decoded again. Every image
// element is stamped with its creation time: after a purchase only the new part is a new element; an angle change
// and a turntable step show only elements prepared in advance.
test('stills fallback decodes each layer once: purchases, angle changes and turntable steps reuse decoded images', async ({ browser }) => {
  const ip = await (await browser.newContext()).newPage();
  const sp = await (await browser.newContext()).newPage();
  guardNetwork(ip); guardNetwork(sp);
  await withoutWebgl(sp);
  await sp.addInitScript(() => {
    const stamp = <T extends object>(el: T): T => Object.assign(el, { seaBorn: performance.now() });
    const create = Document.prototype.createElement;
    Document.prototype.createElement = function (this: Document, ...args: Parameters<Document['createElement']>) {
      return stamp(create.apply(this, args));
    } as typeof create;
    const NativeImage = window.Image;
    window.Image = function (width?: number, height?: number) { return stamp(new NativeImage(width, height)); } as unknown as typeof Image;
    // Background decodes (images not on screen) in flight at once: each competes with what the player is waiting
    // for (CI run 38133130929: four at once made a purchase take 117 ms, budget 100).
    let background = 0;
    const decode = HTMLImageElement.prototype.decode;
    HTMLImageElement.prototype.decode = function (this: HTMLImageElement) {
      if (this.isConnected) return decode.call(this);
      const w = window as unknown as { seaBackgroundMax: number };
      w.seaBackgroundMax = Math.max(w.seaBackgroundMax ?? 0, ++background);
      return decode.call(this).finally(() => { background--; });
    };
    // A machine that is never idle, like the CI runner of run 38106258905: idle callbacks run only at their timeout.
    window.requestIdleCallback = (callback, options) => window.setTimeout(() => callback({ didTimeout: true, timeRemaining: () => 0 }), options?.timeout ?? 2 ** 31 - 1);
  });
  await ip.goto(gameUrl('?role=instructor&lang=en'));
  const code = await instructorSetup(ip, { teams: 2, reveal: 'JIT', timed: false, missions: ['RECOVERY', 'TROOP'] });
  await sp.goto(gameUrl('?role=student&lang=en'));
  await studentJoin(sp, code, 1, 'RECOVERY');
  await sp.check('#plan-confirm');
  await sp.click('#student-start-auction');
  await confirmDialog(sp);
  const showcase = sp.locator('#showcase');
  await expect(showcase.locator('img[data-layer="base"]')).toHaveCount(1);
  const fresh = (since: number) => sp.evaluate(t => [...document.querySelectorAll<HTMLImageElement & { seaBorn: number }>('#showcase img')]
    .filter(img => img.seaBorn >= t).map(img => img.dataset.layer ?? '?'), since);
  const now = () => sp.evaluate(() => performance.now());

  await record(sp, 1, 7, 'ACC-F', 350000);
  await expect(showcase.locator('img[data-layer="ACC-F"]')).toHaveCount(1);
  // A loaded card is the part most likely recorded next: its layer decodes before the purchase, so recording one
  // never waits for a decode (CI run 38135172580: fresh layers took up to 190 ms, budget 100).
  await sp.selectOption('#pos-lot', '5');
  await sp.fill('#card-id', 'COM-E');
  await sp.click('#load-card');
  await expect(showcase).toHaveAttribute('data-prepared', 'true');
  let t = await now();
  await sp.fill('#paid', '600000');
  await sp.click('#record-win');
  await expect(showcase.locator('img[data-layer="COM-E"]')).toHaveCount(1);
  expect(await fresh(t), 'the loaded card was decoded before it was recorded').toEqual([]);

  await expect(showcase).toHaveAttribute('data-prepared', 'true');
  t = await now();
  await showcase.getByRole('radio', { name: 'Rear' }).check();
  await expect(showcase.locator('img[data-layer="base"]')).toHaveAttribute('data-angle', 'rear');
  expect(await fresh(t), 'the rear angle was decoded in advance').toEqual([]);

  // A person may scrub the moment the turntable opens and keep going (CI run 38106258905: the frames either side were
  // still waiting for idle time and two steps took 410 and 720 ms). No pause between steps.
  await expect(showcase).toHaveAttribute('data-prepared', 'true');
  t = await now();
  await showcase.getByRole('radio', { name: 'Turntable' }).check();
  await expect(showcase.locator('img[data-frame="0"]')).toHaveCount(1);
  expect(await fresh(t), 'the turntable frame was prepared in advance').toEqual([]);
  const scrub = showcase.getByRole('slider');
  await scrub.focus();
  const last = Number(await scrub.getAttribute('max'));
  for (const [key, frame] of [['ArrowRight', 1], ['ArrowRight', 2], ['ArrowLeft', 1], ['ArrowLeft', 0], ['End', last]] as const) {
    t = await now();
    await sp.keyboard.press(key);
    await expect(showcase.locator(`img[data-frame="${frame}"]`)).toHaveCount(1);
    expect(await fresh(t), `turntable frame ${frame} was prepared in advance`).toEqual([]);
  }
  expect(await sp.evaluate(() => (window as unknown as { seaBackgroundMax: number }).seaBackgroundMax),
    'background decodes run one at a time').toBe(1);
});

test('every vehicle has its showcase, in 3D and in stills, and every lot its card render', async ({ page, browser }) => {
  guardNetwork(page);
  for (const mission of ['COMBAT', 'RECCE', 'TROOP', 'COMMAND', 'RECOVERY', 'MINE']) {
    const context = await browser.newContext();
    const sp = await context.newPage();
    guardNetwork(sp);
    await withGpu(sp);
    await sp.goto(gameUrl('?role=student&lang=en'));
    await studentJoin(sp, 'SEA3-T2-0123456789ABCDEF', 1, mission);
    await sp.check('#plan-confirm');
    await sp.click('#student-start-auction');
    await confirmDialog(sp);
    await expect(sp.locator('#showcase [role="img"]'), mission).toHaveAttribute('data-ready', 'true', { timeout: 30_000 });
    await context.close();
  }
  // A software WebGL renderer (no GPU) gets the still renders, as a browser without WebGL does.
  await page.goto(gameUrl('?role=student&lang=en'));
  await studentJoin(page, 'SEA3-T2-0123456789ABCDEF', 1, 'COMBAT');
  await page.check('#plan-confirm');
  await page.click('#student-start-auction');
  await confirmDialog(page);
  const software = await page.evaluate(() => {
    const gl = document.createElement('canvas').getContext('webgl2');
    const info = gl?.getExtension('WEBGL_debug_renderer_info');
    return !gl || /swiftshader|llvmpipe|basic render|software/i.test(String(gl.getParameter(info ? info.UNMASKED_RENDERER_WEBGL : gl.RENDERER)));
  });
  if (software) await expect(page.locator('#showcase [role="img"]')).toHaveAttribute('data-mode', 'stills');
  await withoutWebgl(page);
  for (const mission of ['COMBAT', 'RECCE', 'TROOP', 'COMMAND', 'RECOVERY', 'MINE']) {
    await page.goto(gameUrl('?role=student&lang=en'));
    await page.evaluate(() => sessionStorage.clear());
    await page.reload();
    await studentJoin(page, 'SEA3-T2-0123456789ABCDEF', 1, mission);
    await page.check('#plan-confirm');
    await page.click('#student-start-auction');
    await confirmDialog(page);
    await expect(page.locator('#showcase img[data-layer="base"]'), mission).toHaveCount(1);
  }
  // Each card loads in a lot of its own category (lots 1-8: CAP, MOB, FP, PRO, COM, SA, ACC, SE).
  for (const [lot, card] of ['CAP-A', 'MOB-G', 'FP-C', 'PRO-E', 'COM-D', 'SA-F', 'ACC-B', 'SE-U'].entries()) {
    await page.selectOption('#pos-lot', String(lot + 1));
    await page.fill('#card-id', card);
    await page.click('#load-card');
    await expect(page.locator(`figure[data-card="${card}"] img.card-render`), card).toBeVisible();
  }
});
```

```ts
// M2 vertical slice (MPES §17): both roles over file://, one full round, corrections, persistence,
// export/import, EN/FR switching, confirmations, accessibility scans, no network.
import { expect, test } from '@playwright/test';
import { writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { collectConsoleErrors, expectAccessible, gameUrl, guardNetwork } from './helpers.ts';
import { act, confirmDialog, instructorLot, instructorSetup, studentJoin, studentRecord } from './roles.ts';

test('one-round slice: instructor and student, corrections, backup round trip', async ({ browser }, info) => {
  const instructorContext = await browser.newContext();
  const studentContext = await browser.newContext();
  const ip = await instructorContext.newPage(), sp = await studentContext.newPage();
  const requests = [guardNetwork(ip), guardNetwork(sp)];
  const errors = [collectConsoleErrors(ip), collectConsoleErrors(sp)];

  await ip.goto(gameUrl('?role=instructor&lang=en'));
  await expectAccessible(ip, 'instructor setup');
  const code = await instructorSetup(ip, { teams: 3, reveal: 'JIT', timed: false, missions: ['TROOP', 'RECCE', 'COMBAT'] });
  expect(code).toMatch(/^SEA3-T3-[0-9A-F]{16}$/);
  await expectAccessible(ip, 'instructor auction');

  await sp.goto(gameUrl('?role=student&lang=en'));
  await expectAccessible(sp, 'student join');
  await studentJoin(sp, code, 1, 'TROOP');

  // Planning in French; typed text survives switching language back and forth.
  await sp.click('#lang-toggle');
  await expect(sp.locator('html')).toHaveAttribute('lang', 'fr');
  await sp.fill('#plan-plan', 'Capacité d’abord  ✓');
  await sp.click('#lang-toggle');
  await expect(sp.locator('#plan-plan')).toHaveValue('Capacité d’abord  ✓');
  await sp.check('#plan-confirm');
  await expectAccessible(sp, 'student planning');
  await sp.click('#student-start-auction');
  await confirmDialog(sp);

  // Round 1: read each lot's card ID from the instructor screen and mirror it on the student side.
  const plan: { bids: number[]; result: 'sell' | 'unsold' }[] = [
    { bids: [1], result: 'sell' }, { bids: [2, 1], result: 'sell' }, { bids: [], result: 'unsold' }, { bids: [2], result: 'sell' },
    { bids: [3, 2], result: 'unsold' }, { bids: [3], result: 'sell' }, { bids: [2], result: 'sell' }, { bids: [2], result: 'sell' },
    { bids: [], result: 'unsold' }, { bids: [], result: 'unsold' },
  ];
  let studentCost = 0;
  for (const [i, lot] of plan.entries()) {
    const cardId = (await ip.locator('.card-figure[data-card]').getAttribute('data-card'))!;
    await instructorLot(ip, lot.bids, lot.result);
    if (i === 3) {
      // Void and replace with a corrected sale to Team 3; Team 1 is at its 2-win limit.
      await ip.click('#void');
      await ip.fill('#void-reason', 'Wrong team heard');
      await confirmDialog(ip);
      await ip.click('#open-bidding');
      await expect(ip.locator('#bid-1')).toBeDisabled(); // Team 1 already has 2 wins this round
      await ip.click('#correct');
      await ip.selectOption('#correct-team', '3');
      await ip.fill('#correct-price', '9999');
      await ip.fill('#correct-reason', 'Team 3 bid at the back');
      await confirmDialog(ip);
      await expect(ip.locator('#status')).toContainText('not valid');
      await ip.click('#correct');
      await ip.selectOption('#correct-team', '3');
      await ip.fill('#correct-reason', 'Team 3 bid at the back');
      await confirmDialog(ip);
      await expect(ip.locator('#outcome')).toContainText('Team 3');
    }
    const final = /Team (\d+) for \$([\d,]+)/.exec((await ip.locator('#outcome').textContent())!);
    const ours = final && final[1] === '1';
    if (ours) studentCost += Number(final![2]!.replace(/,/g, ''));
    await studentRecord(sp, cardId, ours ? Number(final![2]!.replace(/,/g, '')) : null);
    await act(ip, '#next-lot');
  }
  await expect(ip.locator('#lot-heading')).toHaveText('Round 2 · Lot 1 of 10');
  await expect(sp.locator('#track-heading')).toHaveText('Round 2 · Lot 1 of 10');
  await expect(sp.locator('main')).toContainText(`Spent: $${studentCost.toLocaleString('en-US')}`);
  await ip.locator('details:has(h2:has-text("Ledger")) summary').click();
  await expect(ip.locator('.ledger li')).toHaveCount(12);

  // Persistence: reload keeps both roles where they were.
  await ip.reload();
  await expect(ip.locator('#lot-heading')).toHaveText('Round 2 · Lot 1 of 10');
  await sp.reload();
  await expect(sp.locator('#plan-plan')).toHaveCount(0);
  await expect(sp.locator('#track-heading')).toHaveText('Round 2 · Lot 1 of 10');

  // Export the student backup and import it into a fresh context.
  await sp.click('#menu-button');
  const downloadPromise = sp.waitForEvent('download');
  await sp.locator('dialog button[data-value="export"]').click();
  const download = await downloadPromise;
  expect(download.suggestedFilename()).toMatch(/^sea-student-SEA3-T3-[0-9A-F]{16}-\d{8}-\d{4}\.json$/);
  const backupPath = info.outputPath('student-backup.json');
  await download.saveAs(backupPath);
  const fresh = await (await browser.newContext()).newPage();
  guardNetwork(fresh);
  await fresh.goto(gameUrl('?role=student&lang=fr'));
  // Wrong-role file is rejected without change.
  const wrongPath = info.outputPath('wrong-role.json');
  writeFileSync(wrongPath, '{"format":"SEA-GAME-BACKUP"}');
  await fresh.click('#menu-button');
  let chooser = fresh.waitForEvent('filechooser');
  await fresh.locator('dialog button[data-value="import"]').click();
  await (await chooser).setFiles(wrongPath);
  await expect(fresh.locator('#status')).toContainText('Échec');
  await expect(fresh.locator('#join-code')).toBeVisible();
  await fresh.click('#menu-button');
  chooser = fresh.waitForEvent('filechooser');
  await fresh.locator('dialog button[data-value="import"]').click();
  await (await chooser).setFiles(backupPath);
  await confirmDialog(fresh);
  await expect(fresh.locator('#track-heading')).toHaveText('Ronde 2 · Lot 1 sur 10');
  await expect(fresh.locator('#undo-import')).toBeVisible();
  await fresh.click('#undo-import');
  await expect(fresh.locator('#join-code')).toBeVisible();

  expect(requests.flat()).toEqual([]);
  expect(errors.flat()).toEqual([]);
});
```

```ts
// Screenshot baselines (MPES §16.3): every view of both roles in each phase a legacy fixture reaches, both themes
// on the first screen, and the showcase for every vehicle and angle. Chromium only: the baselines are pixels.
// Update deliberately with `npx playwright test tests/e2e/visual.spec.ts --update-snapshots` and review the diff.
import { expect, test, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { gameUrl, guardNetwork, withoutWebgl } from './helpers.ts';
import { confirmDialog, studentJoin } from './roles.ts';

// Edge reports browserName 'chromium' too; its channel tells it apart.
test.skip(({ browserName, channel }) => browserName !== 'chromium' || !!channel, 'pixel baselines are recorded in Chromium');

const SHOT = { maxDiffPixelRatio: 0.01, animations: 'disabled', caret: 'hide' } as const;
const fixture = (name: string) => JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(readFileSync(`tests/fixtures/legacy/${name}.json`, 'utf8')).state);

async function seeded(page: Page, key: string, name: string, query: string): Promise<void> {
  guardNetwork(page);
  await page.clock.install({ time: new Date('2026-10-10T09:00:00Z') });
  await page.addInitScript(([k, raw]) => { if (!sessionStorage.getItem(k!)) sessionStorage.setItem(k!, raw!); }, [key, fixture(name)]);
  await page.goto(gameUrl(query));
  await page.waitForLoadState('load');
  await page.evaluate(() => Promise.all([...document.images].map(img => img.decode().catch(() => undefined))));
}

for (const theme of ['dark', 'light'] as const) {
  test(`first screen, ${theme} theme`, async ({ page }) => {
    guardNetwork(page);
    await page.goto(gameUrl(`?lang=en${theme === 'light' ? '&theme=light' : ''}`));
    await page.evaluate(() => Promise.all([...document.images].map(img => img.decode())));
    await expect(page).toHaveScreenshot(`chooser-${theme}.png`, SHOT);
  });
}

// G2 item 2: the licence and notices reflowed, at the reference laptop size and the narrowest supported width.
for (const [width, height] of [[1366, 768], [320, 640]] as const) {
  test(`about dialog, licence and notices open, ${width} px`, async ({ page }) => {
    guardNetwork(page);
    await page.setViewportSize({ width, height });
    await page.goto(gameUrl('?lang=en'));
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'About and licences' }).click();
    const dialog = page.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'About this game' });
    for (const name of ['Licence', 'Third-party notices']) await dialog.locator('summary', { hasText: name }).click();
    await dialog.getByRole('heading', { name: 'three.js 0.186.1' }).scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
    await expect(dialog).toHaveScreenshot(`about-${width}.png`, SHOT);
  });
}

for (const name of ['instructor-setup', 'instructor-planning', 'instructor-auction-open-paused', 'instructor-build', 'instructor-closed']) {
  test(`instructor view: ${name}`, async ({ page }) => {
    await seeded(page, 'SEA_INSTRUCTOR_V300', name, '?role=instructor&lang=en');
    await expect(page).toHaveScreenshot(`${name}.png`, { ...SHOT, fullPage: true, mask: [page.locator('.session-code, #timer')] });
  });
}

for (const name of ['student-practice', 'student-planning-fr', 'student-auction', 'student-build', 'student-closed']) {
  test(`student view: ${name}`, async ({ page }) => {
    await seeded(page, 'SEA_STUDENT_V300', name, '?role=student');
    await expect(page).toHaveScreenshot(`${name}.png`, { ...SHOT, fullPage: true });
  });
}

for (const mission of ['COMBAT', 'RECCE', 'TROOP', 'COMMAND', 'RECOVERY', 'MINE']) {
  test(`showcase stills: ${mission}, every angle`, async ({ page }) => {
    guardNetwork(page);
    await withoutWebgl(page);
    await page.goto(gameUrl('?role=student&lang=en'));
    await studentJoin(page, 'SEA3-T2-0123456789ABCDEF', 1, mission);
    await page.check('#plan-confirm');
    await page.click('#student-start-auction');
    await confirmDialog(page);
    // One part in each of seven slots, so every vehicle shows a representative build (at most two wins a round).
    const wins = [[1, 1, 'CAP-E', 350000], [1, 3, 'FP-B', 500000], [2, 6, 'SA-B', 600000], [2, 4, 'PRO-C', 350000],
      [3, 5, 'COM-B', 450000], [3, 2, 'MOB-D', 500000], [4, 7, 'ACC-G', 400000]] as const;
    for (const [round, lot, card, paid] of wins) {
      await page.selectOption('#pos-round', String(round));
      await page.selectOption('#pos-lot', String(lot));
      await page.fill('#card-id', card); await page.click('#load-card'); await page.fill('#paid', String(paid));
      await page.click('#record-win');
    }
    const stage = page.locator('#showcase [role="img"]');
    for (const view of ['front', 'rear', 'turntable'] as const) {
      await page.check(`#showcase-view-${view}`);
      await page.evaluate(() => Promise.all([...document.querySelectorAll<HTMLImageElement>('#showcase img')].map(img => img.decode())));
      await expect(stage).toHaveScreenshot(`showcase-${mission.toLowerCase()}-${view}.png`, SHOT);
    }
  });
}
```

```ts
// G2 item 8: npm run archive:prep -- --apply leaves the smallest folder that restores to the same build. On a fresh
// clone in a temp dir: install and build, plant what must stay and what may go, apply, then restore by RESTORE.md.
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { existsSync, mkdirSync, mkdtempSync, readFileSync, symlinkSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { dirname, join, resolve } from 'node:path';
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { plan, prepare } from '../../scripts/archive-prep.ts';
import { browsersPath } from '../../scripts/browsers.ts';

const ROOT = resolve(import.meta.dirname, '../..');
const npm = (cwd: string, ...args: string[]) => execFileSync(process.platform === 'win32' ? 'npm.cmd' : 'npm', args, { cwd, stdio: 'pipe', shell: process.platform === 'win32' });
const hash = (path: string) => createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(path)).digest('hex');
// Scratch stays inside the project (MPES C-13): .artifacts/tmp, which archive:prep lists as regenerable.
const scratch = (prefix: string) => { mkdirSync(join(ROOT, '.artifacts', 'tmp'), { recursive: true }); return mkdtempSync(join(ROOT, '.artifacts', 'tmp', prefix)); };
const put = (path: string, text = 'x') => { mkdirSync(dirname(path), { recursive: true }); writeFileSync(path, text); };

describe('archive:prep', () => {
  it('removes only the regenerable, keeps the irreplaceable, and restores to the same build', () => {
    const dir = scratch('sea-archive-');
    execFileSync('git', ['clone', '--quiet', '--no-hardlinks', ROOT, dir]);
    npm(dir, 'ci', '--prefer-offline', '--no-audit', '--no-fund');
    npm(dir, 'run', 'build');
    const built = hash(join(dir, 'dist', 'index.html'));

    const keep = ['.artifacts/renders/v3/combat-hero.png', '.artifacts/concepts-v3/FP-C.png', '.artifacts/models/combat.glb',
      '.artifacts/logs/verify.log', '.artifacts/review/0.5.0.0.html', '_archive/recycle/old.txt', '_archive/x/__pycache__/keep.pyc'];
    const go = ['.artifacts/ms-playwright/chromium/chrome.exe', '.artifacts/gallery/after/chooser.png', '.artifacts/tools/blender/blender.exe',
      '.artifacts/packed/models.glb', 'test-results/a.txt', 'art/blender/sea/__pycache__/geo.pyc'];
    for (const p of [...keep, ...go]) put(join(dir, p));
    // A gallery tag tree links to a kept folder: removing the link must not touch its target.
    mkdirSync(join(dir, '.artifacts', 'gallery', 'v0'));
    symlinkSync(join(dir, '.artifacts', 'renders'), join(dir, '.artifacts', 'gallery', 'v0', 'node_modules'), 'junction');

    expect(plan(dir).map(e => e.path)).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(['node_modules', 'dist', '.artifacts/gallery', 'art/blender/sea/__pycache__']));
    prepare(dir, true);
    for (const p of keep) expect(existsSync(join(dir, p)), `kept ${p}`).toBe(true);
    for (const p of [...go, 'node_modules', 'dist']) expect(existsSync(join(dir, p)), `removed ${p}`).toBe(false);
    expect(execFileSync('git', ['status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=no'], { cwd: dir, encoding: 'utf8' })).toBe('');
    const restore = readFileSync(join(dir, 'RESTORE.md'), 'utf8');
    expect(restore).toContain(built);

    npm(dir, 'ci', '--prefer-offline', '--no-audit', '--no-fund');
    npm(dir, 'run', 'build');
    expect(hash(join(dir, 'dist', 'index.html'))).toBe(built);
  }, 600_000);

  it('refuses a target under a linked folder, which would lead removal outside the project', () => {
    const dir = scratch('sea-archive-linked-'), outside = scratch('sea-archive-outside-');
    execFileSync('git', ['init', '--quiet'], { cwd: dir });
    put(join(outside, 'gallery', 'precious.txt'));
    symlinkSync(outside, join(dir, '.artifacts'), 'junction');
    expect(() => plan(dir)).toThrow(/\.artifacts is a link/);
    expect(() => prepare(dir, true)).toThrow(/\.artifacts is a link/);
    expect(existsSync(join(outside, 'gallery', 'precious.txt'))).toBe(true);
  });

  it('installs test browsers where playwright.config.ts looks for them', () => {
    expect(browsersPath({}, ROOT)).toBe(join(ROOT, '.artifacts', 'ms-playwright'));
    expect(browsersPath({ PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH: 'X:/b' }, ROOT)).toBe('X:/b');
    expect(browsersPath({ CI: 'true' }, ROOT)).toBeUndefined();
    expect(readFileSync(join(ROOT, 'playwright.config.ts'), 'utf8')).toContain("path.resolve('.artifacts/ms-playwright')");
  });

  it('refuses a path that holds a tracked file', () => {
    const dir = scratch('sea-archive-tracked-');
    const git = (...args: string[]) => execFileSync('git', args, { cwd: dir, stdio: 'pipe' });
    git('init', '--quiet');
    put(join(dir, 'dist', 'index.html'));
    git('add', 'dist/index.html');
    expect(() => plan(dir)).toThrow(/tracked/);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { inflateRawSync } from 'node:zlib';
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { MAX_BYTES, MODELS_DIR, RENDERS_DIR, render, sha256 } from '../../build/render.ts';

const COPYRIGHT = 'Copyright (c) 2026 Shafiqur Rahman Khan';

describe('single-file build (RQ-01, RQ-24, RQ-25, RQ-27)', async () => {
  const html = await render();
  const script = /<script>([\s\S]*)<\/script>\s*<\/body>/.exec(html)?.[1] ?? '';
  const style = /<style>([\s\S]*?)<\/style>/.exec(html)?.[1] ?? '';
  const csp = /http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="([^"]+)"/.exec(html)?.[1] ?? '';

  it('embeds the four-part game version; npm holds its first three parts (MPES §19.2)', () => {
    const pkg = JSON.parse(readFileSync('package.json', 'utf8')) as { version: string; gameVersion: string };
    expect(pkg.gameVersion).toMatch(/^\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+$/);
    expect(pkg.version).toBe(pkg.gameVersion.split('.').slice(0, 3).join('.'));
    expect(script).toContain(JSON.stringify(pkg.gameVersion));
  });
  it('is deterministic', async () => {
    expect(await render()).toBe(html);
  });
  it('has one executable inline script and one inline style, both hash-pinned in the CSP', () => {
    expect(html.match(/<script>/g)).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(html.match(/<script\b/g)).toHaveLength(3); // plus the inert renders and models data blocks
    expect(html.match(/<style/g)).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(csp).toContain(`'sha256-${sha256(script)}'`);
    expect(csp).toContain(`'sha256-${sha256(style)}'`);
  });
  it('locks the CSP down', () => {
    for (const directive of ["default-src 'none'", "connect-src 'none'", "object-src 'none'", "base-uri 'none'", "form-action 'none'", "frame-src 'none'"]) {
      expect(csp).toContain(directive);
    }
    expect(csp).not.toMatch(/unsafe-(inline|eval)/);
    expect(csp).not.toMatch(/https?:/);
    // Imagery and models are embedded data only; the models carry no textures, so nothing creates blob: URLs or workers.
    expect(csp).toContain('img-src data:;');
    expect(csp).not.toContain('blob:');
  });
  it('never mentions GitHub, which is temporary QA space (D-13)', () => {
    expect(html).not.toMatch(/github/i);
  });
  it('references no external resources', () => {
    expect(html).not.toMatch(/<(link|img|iframe|object|embed)\b/i);
    expect(html).not.toMatch(/\b(src|href)="(https?:)?\/\//i);
  });
  it('caps the file at 50 MB (MPES §14)', () => {
    expect(MAX_BYTES).toBe(50 * 1024 * 1024);
  });
  it('embeds the licence and third-party notices and stays within the size limit', () => {
    expect(html).toContain('bundles one third-party library, three.js');
    expect(html).toContain('Copyright © 2010-2026 three.js authors');
    expect(html).toContain(COPYRIGHT);
    expect(Buffer.byteLength(html)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(MAX_BYTES);
  });
  // The owner is the creator and sole copyright holder (G2): the licence, the notices, the package and the About text.
  it('names the creator as copyright holder everywhere', () => {
    expect(readFileSync('LICENSE', 'utf8')).toContain(COPYRIGHT);
    expect(readFileSync('LICENSE', 'utf8')).not.toContain('contributors');
    expect(readFileSync('THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md', 'utf8')).toContain(COPYRIGHT);
    expect((JSON.parse(readFileSync('package.json', 'utf8')) as { author: string }).author).toBe('Shafiqur Rahman Khan');
    for (const lang of ['en', 'fr']) {
      const strings = JSON.parse(readFileSync(`content/strings.${lang}.json`, 'utf8')) as Record<string, string>;
      expect(strings['about.body'], lang).toContain('© 2026 Shafiqur Rahman Khan');
    }
  });
  it('embeds the committed renders once, as an inert JSON block of AVIF data URIs matching the manifest (MPES §11)', () => {
    const block = /<script type="application\/json" id="sea-renders">([^<]*)<\/script>/.exec(html)?.[1];
    expect(block).toBeDefined();
    const embedded = JSON.parse(block!) as Record<string, { src: string; kind: string; depth?: unknown }>;
    const manifest = JSON.parse(readFileSync(`${RENDERS_DIR}/manifest.json`, 'utf8')) as { entries: { id: string; file: string }[] };
    expect(Object.keys(embedded).sort()).toEqual(manifest.entries.map(e => e.id).sort());
    for (const e of manifest.entries) {
      expect(embedded[e.id]!.src).toBe('data:image/avif;base64,' + readFileSync(`${RENDERS_DIR}/${e.file}`).toString('base64'));
    }
    // Every build layer carries its camera distance, the draw order of MPES §10.2.
    const layers = Object.values(embedded).filter(r => r.kind === 'build-layer');
    expect(layers.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    for (const r of layers) expect(typeof r.depth === 'number' && r.depth > 0).toBe(true);
  });
  it('embeds the committed showcase models once, raw-deflated and base64-encoded, matching the manifest (MPES §10)', () => {
    const block = /<script type="application\/octet-stream" id="sea-models">([A-Za-z0-9+/=]*)<\/script>/.exec(html)?.[1];
    expect(block).toBeTruthy();
    const glb = inflateRawSync(Buffer.from(block!, 'base64'));
    const manifest = JSON.parse(readFileSync(`${MODELS_DIR}/manifest.json`, 'utf8')) as { file: string };
    expect(glb.equals(readFileSync(`${MODELS_DIR}/${manifest.file}`))).toBe(true);
    expect(glb.subarray(0, 4).toString('latin1')).toBe('glTF');
    // No textures: GLTFLoader would need blob: URLs for them, which the CSP forbids.
    const json = JSON.parse(glb.subarray(20, 20 + glb.readUInt32LE(12)).toString('utf8')) as { images?: unknown[] };
    expect(json.images ?? []).toHaveLength(0);
  });
  it('has no duplicate static ids', () => {
    const ids = [...html.matchAll(/\sid="([^"]+)"/g)].map(match => match[1]);
    expect(new Set(ids).size).toBe(ids.length);
  });
});
```

```ts
// G2 item 7: docs/CODEBASE.md rebuilds the tree. This test reads it with its own parser, following only the rules the
// file states, writes every text file into a temp dir and checks every tracked file's SHA-256 against the repository.
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { mkdirSync, mkdtempSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { dirname, join, resolve } from 'node:path';
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { codebase } from '../../scripts/codebase.ts';

const sha = (data: Buffer | string) => createHash('sha256').update(data).digest('hex');
// Scratch stays inside the project (MPES C-13): .artifacts/tmp, which archive:prep lists as regenerable.
const TMP = resolve(import.meta.dirname, '../../.artifacts/tmp');
const scratch = (prefix: string) => { mkdirSync(TMP, { recursive: true }); return mkdtempSync(join(TMP, prefix)); };
const DOC = readFileSync('docs/CODEBASE.md', 'utf8');

/** Text sections: paths, hash, size and the file content rebuilt from the fenced block. */
function textFiles(doc: string): { paths: string[]; hash: string; bytes: number; content: string }[] {
  const lines = doc.split('\n');
  const start = lines.indexOf('## Text files'), end = lines.indexOf('## Binary files');
  const out: { paths: string[]; hash: string; bytes: number; content: string }[] = [];
  for (let i = start; i < end; i++) {
    const head = /^Paths: (.+)\. SHA-256 `([0-9a-f]{64})`, (\d+) bytes(, no final line end)?\.$/.exec(lines[i]!);
    if (!head) continue;
    const open = /^(`{3,})[a-z]*$/.exec(lines[i + 2]!);
    if (!open) throw new Error(`no fence after line ${i + 1}`);
    const body: string[] = [];
    let j = i + 3;
    for (; lines[j] !== open[1]; j++) body.push(lines[j]!);
    let content = body.length ? `${body.join('\n')}\n` : '';
    if (head[4]) content = content.slice(0, -1);
    out.push({ paths: [...head[1]!.matchAll(/`([^`]+)`/g)].map(m => m[1]!), hash: head[2]!, bytes: Number(head[3]), content });
    i = j;
  }
  return out;
}

/** Rows of a table section: path and hash. */
function rows(doc: string, title: string): Map<string, string> {
  const section = doc.split(`## ${title}\n`)[1]!.split('\n## ')[0]!;
  return new Map([...section.matchAll(/^\| `([^`]+)` \| *\d* *\| *(?:`([0-9a-f]{64})`)? *\|/gm)].map(m => [m[1]!, m[2] ?? '']));
}

describe('docs/CODEBASE.md', () => {
  it('rebuilds every tracked file: text verbatim, binaries and separate documents by hash', () => {
    const tracked = execFileSync('git', ['ls-files', '-z'], { encoding: 'utf8', maxBuffer: 1 << 26 }).split('\0').filter(Boolean);
    const dir = scratch('sea-codebase-');
    const listed = new Map<string, string>();
    for (const { paths, hash, bytes, content } of textFiles(DOC)) {
      expect(sha(content), paths[0]).toBe(hash);
      expect(Buffer.byteLength(content), paths[0]).toBe(bytes);
      for (const path of paths) {
        mkdirSync(dirname(join(dir, path)), { recursive: true });
        writeFileSync(join(dir, path), content);
        listed.set(path, sha(readFileSync(join(dir, path))));
      }
    }
    const binaries = rows(DOC, 'Binary files'), separate = rows(DOC, 'Documents kept separately');
    for (const [path, hash] of [...binaries, ...separate]) {
      expect(listed.has(path), `${path} listed twice`).toBe(false);
      listed.set(path, hash);
    }
    for (const path of tracked) {
      if (path === 'docs/CODEBASE.md') { expect(separate.has(path)).toBe(true); continue; }
      expect(listed.get(path), path).toBe(sha(readFileSync(path)));
    }
    expect(new Set(listed.keys())).toEqual(new Set([...tracked, 'docs/CODEBASE.md']));
    expect(binaries.size).toBeGreaterThan(800);
    // Explicit bound: it writes about 150 files and hashes about 1,000 (60 MB). Usually 0.2-0.4 s, but one run on
    // 2026-10-11 took 7.1 s and hit the 5 s default (cause unknown; correct result; not reproduced in 22 runs).
  }, 60_000);

  it('keeps the specification out and has no hand edits', () => {
    expect(DOC).not.toMatch(/^Paths: .*`docs\/MPES\.md`/m);
    expect(DOC, 'run npm run codebase').toBe(codebase());
  }, 60_000); // The same hashing as above, so the same bound.
});
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import en from '../../content/strings.en.json' with { type: 'json' };
import fr from '../../content/strings.fr.json' with { type: 'json' };
import { detectLanguage, translate } from '../../source/ui/i18n.ts';

describe('strings (RQ-19)', () => {
  it('EN and FR have exactly the same keys', () => {
    expect(Object.keys(fr).sort()).toEqual(Object.keys(en).sort());
  });
  it('every string is non-empty and keeps the same placeholders in both languages', () => {
    const placeholders = (text: string) => [...text.matchAll(/\{(\w+)\}/g)].map(match => match[1]).sort();
    for (const key of Object.keys(en) as (keyof typeof en)[]) {
      expect(en[key].trim(), key).not.toBe('');
      expect(fr[key].trim(), key).not.toBe('');
      expect(placeholders(fr[key]), key).toEqual(placeholders(en[key]));
    }
  });
  it('French uses typographic apostrophes and no straight quotes', () => {
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(fr)) expect(value, key).not.toMatch(/'/);
  });

      }
    }
  });

    for (const text of [en['app.unsupported'], fr['app.unsupported']]) {

      expect(text).not.toMatch(/Safari|macOS|iPad|iOS|Android|ChromeOS|Linux/);
    }
  });
  it('substitutes placeholders and detects language', () => {
    expect(translate('en', 'chooser.version', { version: '9.9.9' })).toContain('9.9.9');
    expect(detectLanguage('?lang=fr', 'en-CA')).toBe('fr');
    expect(detectLanguage('', 'fr-CA')).toBe('fr');
    expect(detectLanguage('?lang=xx', 'de')).toBe('en');
  });
});
```

```ts
// R-ARCH-2 and MPES §8.1/§8.7: the controller persists every committed state, including a deliberate reset.
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { Controller } from '../../source/app/controller.ts';
import { memoryStoragePort } from '../../source/app/ports.ts';

interface Toy { readonly code: string | null; readonly n: number }
const KEY = 'TOY';

function controller(initial: Toy, storage = memoryStoragePort()) {
  return {
    storage,
    c: new Controller<Toy>(initial, {
      key: KEY, storage, validate: () => undefined,
      serialize: state => state.code === null ? null : JSON.stringify(state),
    }),
  };
}

describe('Controller persistence', () => {
  it('saves each committed change', () => {
    const { c, storage } = controller({ code: null, n: 0 });
    c.dispatch(() => ({ code: 'A', n: 1 }));
    expect(storage.data.get(KEY)).toBe('{"code":"A","n":1}');
  });

  it('a reset to an unsaved shell clears the save, so a reload does not restore the old session', () => {
    const { c, storage } = controller({ code: null, n: 0 });
    c.dispatch(() => ({ code: 'A', n: 1 }));
    c.replace({ code: null, n: 0 });
    expect(storage.data.has(KEY)).toBe(false);
  });

  it('restoring from a loaded save and then resetting also clears it', () => {
    const storage = memoryStoragePort();
    storage.data.set(KEY, '{"code":"A","n":1}');
    const { c } = controller({ code: 'A', n: 1 }, storage);
    c.dispatch(() => ({ code: null, n: 0 }));
    expect(storage.data.has(KEY)).toBe(false);
  });

  it('never deletes data it did not write (an unreadable save stays for support, §8.7)', () => {
    const storage = memoryStoragePort();
    storage.data.set(KEY, 'unreadable');
    const { c } = controller({ code: null, n: 0 }, storage);
    c.dispatch(state => ({ ...state, n: 1 }));
    expect(storage.data.get(KEY)).toBe('unreadable');
  });

  it('reports a failed removal as a failed save', () => {
    const storage = { ...memoryStoragePort(), remove: () => false };
    const { c } = controller({ code: null, n: 0 }, storage);
    c.dispatch(() => ({ code: 'A', n: 1 }));
    c.replace({ code: null, n: 0 });
    expect(c.saveFailed).toBe(true);
  });
});
```

```ts
// S1 support (MPES §1.2, §16.6, RQ-30): every control the quick-start guide names exists in the app,

import fr from '../../content/strings.fr.json' with { type: 'json' };

const [english, french] = guide.split('## Français');
const PHRASES = ['The apps do not connect to each other', 'Les applications ne sont pas reliées', 'Français / English', 'Team N', 'équipe N'];

function labels(section: string): string[] {
  return [...section.matchAll(/\*\*([^*]+)\*\*/g)].map(m => m[1]!.split(' → ').pop()!.trim())
    .map(label => label.replace(/ Team N$| à l’équipe N$/, ''))
    .filter(label => !PHRASES.some(p => label.includes(p)));
}

describe('quick-start guide matches the interface (S1)', () => {
  for (const [name, section, strings] of [['English', english!, en], ['French', french!, fr]] as const) {
    it(`${name}: every named control exists`, () => {
      const values = Object.values(strings as Record<string, string>).map(v => v.replace(/ /g, ' '));
      const found = labels(section);
      expect(found.length).toBeGreaterThan(15);
      for (const label of found) expect(values.some(v => v === label || v.startsWith(label)), label).toBe(true);
    });
  }
});
```

### tests/unit/glb.test.ts

Paths: `tests/unit/glb.test.ts`. SHA-256 `5e1c561824daa789642c8b5491d0af6b1d801daa1fd17e0d8613bda6c6026c3d`, 3523 bytes.

```ts
// MPES §10, §14: the embedded model holds all six vehicles, but the game parses only the team's vehicle, so the
// 3D stage is ready within budget. vehicleGlb narrows the GLB's scene to that vehicle's node; the loader then
// fetches only what that node references.
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { vehicleGlb } from '../../source/showcase/glb.ts';
import { VEHICLE } from '../../source/showcase/renders.ts';

interface Gltf { scene?: number; scenes: { nodes: number[] }[]; nodes: { name?: string; children?: number[] }[] }

function glb(json: object, bin: Uint8Array): ArrayBuffer {
  const text = new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(json));
  const jsonLen = Math.ceil(text.length / 4) * 4, binLen = Math.ceil(bin.length / 4) * 4;
  const out = new Uint8Array(12 + 8 + jsonLen + 8 + binLen);
  const view = new DataView(out.buffer);
  view.setUint32(0, 0x46546c67, true); view.setUint32(4, 2, true); view.setUint32(8, out.length, true);
  view.setUint32(12, jsonLen, true); view.setUint32(16, 0x4e4f534a, true);
  out.fill(0x20, 20, 20 + jsonLen); out.set(text, 20);
  view.setUint32(20 + jsonLen, binLen, true); view.setUint32(24 + jsonLen, 0x004e4942, true);
  out.set(bin, 28 + jsonLen);
  return out.buffer;
}

function parse(buffer: ArrayBuffer): { json: Gltf; bin: Uint8Array; length: number } {
  const view = new DataView(buffer);
  const jsonLen = view.getUint32(12, true);
  const json = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(new Uint8Array(buffer, 20, jsonLen))) as Gltf;
  const binLen = view.getUint32(20 + jsonLen, true);
  return { json, bin: new Uint8Array(buffer, 28 + jsonLen, binLen), length: view.getUint32(8, true) };
}

describe('vehicleGlb (MPES §10, §14)', () => {
  const json = { asset: { version: '2.0' }, scene: 0, scenes: [{ nodes: [0, 1] }], nodes: [{ name: 'combat', children: [2] }, { name: 'recce' }, { name: 'base' }] };
  const bin = new Uint8Array([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]);

  it("keeps only the vehicle's root node in the scene, and the binary chunk unchanged", () => {
    const out = parse(vehicleGlb(glb(json, bin), 'recce')!);
    expect(out.json.scenes).toEqual([{ nodes: [1] }]);
    expect(out.json.scene).toBe(0);
    expect(out.json.nodes).toEqual(json.nodes);
    expect([...out.bin]).toEqual([...bin]);
  });

  it('writes a valid GLB: 4-byte aligned chunks and the total length in the header', () => {
    const buffer = vehicleGlb(glb(json, bin), 'combat')!;
    const out = parse(buffer);
    expect(out.length).toBe(buffer.byteLength);
    expect(new DataView(buffer).getUint32(12, true) % 4).toBe(0);
    expect(out.json.scenes).toEqual([{ nodes: [0] }]);
  });

  it('returns null for a vehicle that is not a root node, or for data that is not a GLB', () => {
    expect(vehicleGlb(glb(json, bin), 'base')).toBeNull();
    expect(vehicleGlb(glb(json, bin), 'mine-clearing')).toBeNull();
    expect(vehicleGlb(new Uint8Array(32).buffer, 'combat')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('finds every vehicle in the committed model', () => {
    const manifest = JSON.parse(readFileSync('content/models/manifest.json', 'utf8')) as { file: string };
    const file = readFileSync(`content/models/${manifest.file}`);
    const buffer = file.buffer.slice(file.byteOffset, file.byteOffset + file.byteLength);
    for (const stem of Object.values(VEHICLE)) {
      const out = parse(vehicleGlb(buffer, stem)!);
      expect(out.json.scenes[0]!.nodes.map(i => out.json.nodes[i]!.name)).toEqual([stem]);
    }
  });
});
```

```ts
// RQ-03, RQ-06, RQ-07, RQ-08, RQ-10, RQ-11: instructor commands and their rejections.
import fc from 'fast-check';
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { DomainError } from '../../source/domain/errors.ts';
import * as I from '../../source/domain/instructor.ts';
import { instructorForSave, validateInstructor } from '../../source/domain/saves.ts';
import type { RevealMode } from '../../source/domain/session.ts';
import { specDealVectors } from './spec.ts';

const SEED = '00000000000000000000000000000000';
const VECTOR = specDealVectors()[SEED]!;
const code = (fn: () => unknown) => { try { fn(); } catch (e) { return e instanceof DomainError ? e.code : String(e); } return 'no error'; };
let t = 1_900_000_000_000;
const now = (step = 1000) => (t += step);

function session(teams = 3, revealMode: RevealMode = 'JIT', timingMode: 'TIMED' | 'UNTIMED' = 'TIMED'): I.InstructorState {
  let s = I.generateSession(I.instructorShell('en'), { teamCount: teams, revealMode, timingMode, bidSeconds: 30, token: '0123456789ABCDEF', seed: SEED });
  s = I.startPractice(s);
  for (const a of ['reveal', 'open', 'accept', 'close'] as const) s = I.practiceStep(s, a);
  s = I.openPlanning(s);
  for (let id = 1; id <= teams; id++) s = I.selectMission(s, id, 'TROOP');
  return I.startAuction(s);
}
const bidFor = (s: I.InstructorState, team: number) => I.acceptBid(s, team, I.nextOffer(s)!, now());
const valid = (s: I.InstructorState) => expect(validateInstructor(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(instructorForSave(s))))).toEqual(instructorForSave(s));

describe('setup, practice and planning (RQ-03, RQ-11)', () => {
  it('generates a session whose market is the Appendix B deal', () => {
    const s = I.generateSession(I.instructorShell(), { teamCount: 4, revealMode: 'MANUAL', timingMode: 'UNTIMED', bidSeconds: 45, token: 'ABCDEF0123456789', seed: SEED });
    expect(s.sessionCode).toBe('SEA3-T4-ABCDEF0123456789');
    expect(s.market.map(r => r.map(c => c.id))).toEqual(VECTOR);
    expect(s.teams).toHaveLength(4);
    expect(s.revealed).toBe(false);
    valid(s);
  });
  it('rejects bad options', () => {
    const shell = I.instructorShell();
    const base = { teamCount: 4, revealMode: 'JIT', timingMode: 'TIMED', bidSeconds: 30, token: '0123456789ABCDEF', seed: SEED } as const;
    expect(code(() => I.generateSession(shell, { ...base, teamCount: 11 }))).toBe('team');
    expect(code(() => I.generateSession(shell, { ...base, bidSeconds: 9 }))).toBe('time');
    expect(code(() => I.generateSession(shell, { ...base, token: 'xyz' }))).toBe('code');
    expect(code(() => I.generateSession(shell, { ...base, seed: 'abc' }))).toBe('invalid-state');
  });
  it('keeps practice isolated and requires a closed practice lot before planning', () => {
    let s = I.generateSession(I.instructorShell(), { teamCount: 2, revealMode: 'JIT', timingMode: 'TIMED', bidSeconds: 30, token: '0123456789ABCDEF', seed: SEED });
    s = I.startPractice(s);
    expect(code(() => I.openPlanning(s))).toBe('phase');
    expect(code(() => I.practiceStep(s, 'open'))).toBe('phase');
    for (const a of ['reveal', 'open', 'accept', 'close'] as const) { s = I.practiceStep(s, a); valid(s); }
    expect(s.ledger).toEqual([]);
    expect(s.teams.every(team => team.purchases.length === 0 && team.cost === 0)).toBe(true);
    s = I.openPlanning(s);
    expect(s.practice).toEqual({ revealed: false, open: false, leader: false, closed: false });
  });
  it('requires every mission before the auction and then locks them', () => {
    let s = I.generateSession(I.instructorShell(), { teamCount: 2, revealMode: 'JIT', timingMode: 'TIMED', bidSeconds: 30, token: '0123456789ABCDEF', seed: SEED });
    s = I.startPractice(s);
    for (const a of ['reveal', 'open', 'accept', 'close'] as const) s = I.practiceStep(s, a);
    s = I.openPlanning(s);
    s = I.selectMission(s, 1, 'COMBAT');
    expect(code(() => I.startAuction(s))).toBe('mission');
    s = I.startAuction(I.selectMission(s, 2, 'MINE'));
    expect(s.teams.map(team => team.lockedMission)).toEqual(['COMBAT', 'MINE']);
    expect(code(() => I.selectMission(s, 1, 'RECCE'))).toBe('phase');
  });
});

describe('live bidding (RQ-06, RQ-07)', () => {
  it('starts at the start price, steps by $50,000 and ignores a stale repeated click', () => {
    let s = I.openBidding(session(), now());
    expect(I.nextOffer(s)).toBe(40_000_000); // CAP-G
    const shown = I.nextOffer(s)!;
    s = I.acceptBid(s, 1, shown, now());
    expect(s.currentBid).toBe(40_000_000);

    s = I.openBidding(s, now());
    s = I.pause(s, now());
    expect(code(() => bidFor(s, 1))).toBe('paused');

    s = bidFor(s, 1);
    expect(code(() => I.extend(s, now()))).toBe('phase');
  });
  it('MANUAL mode requires reveal; JIT reveals automatically', () => {
    let s = session(2, 'MANUAL');
    expect(s.revealed).toBe(false);
    s = I.reveal(s);
    expect(code(() => I.reveal(s))).toBe('phase');
    expect(session(2, 'JIT').revealed).toBe(true);
  });
});

describe('outcomes, corrections and void (RQ-06, RQ-08)', () => {

    let s = bidFor(I.openBidding(session(), now()), 1);
    expect(code(() => I.commitSale(s, 2, 40_000_000))).toBe('reason');
    expect(code(() => I.commitSale(s, 1, 42_000_000, 'typo'))).toBe('money');
    const corrected = I.commitSale(s, 2, 50_000_000, 'Team 2 bid was missed');
    expect(corrected.ledger.at(-1)).toMatchObject({ kind: 'SALE', team: 2, price: 50_000_000, reason: 'Team 2 bid was missed' });
    s = I.commitSale(s, 1, 40_000_000);
    expect(s.ledger.at(-1)).toEqual({ seq: 1, kind: 'SALE', round: 1, lot: 1, card: 'CAP-G', team: 1, price: 40_000_000 });
    expect(s.teams[0]!.cost).toBe(40_000_000);
    expect(s.teams[0]!.totals.CAP).toBe(4);
    expect(code(() => I.commitUnsold(s))).toBe('phase');
    valid(s);
  });
  it('allows unsold with a leader, and void then requires a replacement before advancing', () => {
    let s = bidFor(I.openBidding(session(), now()), 3);
    s = I.commitUnsold(s);

    s = I.voidCurrent(s, 'Team 3 did bid');
    expect(code(() => I.advance(s))).toBe('phase');
    expect(code(() => I.voidCurrent(s, 'again'))).toBe('phase');
    s = I.commitSale(bidFor(I.openBidding(s, now()), 3), 3, 40_000_000);
    s = I.voidCurrent(s, 'Price disputed');
    expect(s.teams[2]!.purchases).toEqual([]);
    expect(s.ledger.map(e => e.kind)).toEqual(['UNSOLD', 'VOID', 'SALE', 'VOID']);
    expect(s.ledger.at(-1)).toMatchObject({ ref: 3, team: 3, price: 40_000_000 });
    s = I.commitUnsold(I.openBidding(s, now()));
    s = I.advance(s);
    expect([s.round, s.lot]).toEqual([0, 1]);
    valid(s);
  });
  it('enforces two wins per team per round, including corrected sales', () => {
    let s = session();
    for (let lot = 0; lot < 2; lot++) s = I.advance(I.commitSale(bidFor(I.openBidding(s, now()), 1), 1, I.currentCard(s).start));
    s = I.openBidding(s, now());
    expect(code(() => bidFor(s, 1))).toBe('limit');
    s = bidFor(s, 2);
    expect(code(() => I.commitSale(s, 1, s.currentBid!, 'correction'))).toBe('limit');
  });
  it('stops repeated corrections before the 210-entry ledger is exhausted', () => {

// Owner request 2026-10-11 (MPES §6.5): when no team may win more this round, one command closes the rest unsold.
describe('closing a round no team can win in', () => {
  /** Two wins each for teams 1..n in the current round, from the current lot on. */
  function fill(s: I.InstructorState, teams: number): I.InstructorState {
    for (let id = 1; id <= teams; id++) {
      for (let k = 0; k < 2; k++) s = I.advance(I.commitSale(bidFor(I.openBidding(s, now()), id), id, I.currentCard(s).start));

    expect(I.lotsNobodyCanWin(s)).toBe(6);
    const before = s.ledger.length;

    expect(closed.ledger.slice(before).map(e => [e.kind, e.lot])).toEqual([5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10].map(lot => ['UNSOLD', lot]));
    expect([closed.round, closed.lot]).toEqual([1, 0]);

function playToBuild(s: I.InstructorState): I.InstructorState {
  while (s.phase === 'auction') {
    if (!I.currentOutcome(s)) {
      s = I.openBidding(s, now());
      const team = s.teams.find(x => x.purchasesByRound[s.round]! < 2 && (s.lot + x.id) % 3 === 0);
      if (team) { const leading = bidFor(s, team.id); s = I.commitSale(leading, team.id, leading.currentBid!); } else s = I.commitUnsold(s);
    }
    s = I.advance(s);
  }
  return s;
}

describe('build, private submissions and close (RQ-03, RQ-13)', () => {
  it('runs all 70 lots into build, then submissions in private mode, debrief and closed', () => {
    let s = playToBuild(session(3, 'ROUND'));
    expect(s.phase).toBe('build');
    expect(s.ledger).toHaveLength(70);
    expect(s.teams.every(team => team.purchasesByRound.every(n => n <= 2))).toBe(true);
    valid(s);
    s = I.openSubmissions(s);
    expect(code(() => I.setProfit(s, 1, '100'))).toBe('phase');
    s = I.setPrivateEntry(s, true);
    s = I.setSubmitted(I.setProfit(s, 1, '100000.25'), 1, true);
    expect(code(() => I.setProfit(s, 2, '-5'))).toBe('money');
    expect(I.pendingSubmissions(s)).toEqual([2, 3]);
    expect(instructorForSave(s).privateEntry).toBe(false);
    s = I.closeRoom(I.closeSubmissions(s));
    expect(s.phase).toBe('closed');
    expect(s.teams[0]!.profit).toBe(10_000_025);
    valid(s);
  });
});

describe('every reachable state validates and equals its ledger replay (RQ-08 property)', () => {
  it('holds for random command sequences', () => {
    const action = fc.oneof(
      fc.constant({ kind: 'open' as const }), fc.constant({ kind: 'unsold' as const }), fc.constant({ kind: 'advance' as const }),
      fc.constant({ kind: 'pause' as const }), fc.constant({ kind: 'resume' as const }), fc.constant({ kind: 'extend' as const }),
      fc.record({ kind: fc.constant('bid' as const), team: fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 4 }) }),
      fc.record({ kind: fc.constant('sale' as const), team: fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 4 }), steps: fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 3 }) }),
      fc.record({ kind: fc.constant('void' as const) }), fc.constant({ kind: 'close-round' as const }),
    );
    fc.assert(fc.property(fc.array(action, { maxLength: 120 }), fc.constantFrom<RevealMode>('ROUND', 'JIT', 'MANUAL'), (actions, mode) => {
      let s = session(4, mode);
      for (const a of actions) {
        const before = s;
        try {
          switch (a.kind) {
            case 'open': s = I.openBidding(s.revealed ? s : I.reveal(s), now()); break;
            case 'bid': s = bidFor(s, a.team); break;
            case 'sale': s = I.commitSale(s, a.team, I.currentCard(s).start + a.steps * 5_000_000, 'adjusted'); break;
            case 'unsold': s = I.commitUnsold(s); break;
            case 'void': s = I.voidCurrent(s, 'property'); break;
            case 'advance': s = I.advance(s); break;
            case 'close-round': s = I.closeRound(s); break;
            case 'pause': s = I.pause(s, now()); break;
            case 'resume': s = I.resume(s, now()); break;
            case 'extend': s = I.extend(s, now()); break;
          }
        } catch (e) {

        }

      }
    }), { numRuns: 60, seed: 20261009 });

});
```

// G2 item 6 (Omni 5.1.1 §6.2, AGENTS.md rule 18): docs/MPES.md alone rebuilds the project, without code. It has no
// code block, names every tracked source, test, script, configuration and document file, every npm script and every
// pinned package at its exact version, and states the Content-Security-Policy the build writes.
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

const MPES = readFileSync('docs/MPES.md', 'utf8');
const pkg = JSON.parse(readFileSync('package.json', 'utf8')) as {
  scripts: Record<string, string>; dependencies: Record<string, string>; devDependencies: Record<string, string>; overrides: Record<string, string>;
};

describe('docs/MPES.md', () => {
  it('holds no code block', () => {
    const fences = MPES.split('\n').map((line, i) => [i + 1, line] as const).filter(([, line]) => /^\s*(```|~~~)/.test(line));
    expect(fences.map(([n]) => n)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('names every tracked file a rebuild writes by hand', () => {
    const tracked = execFileSync('git', ['ls-files', '-z'], { encoding: 'utf8', maxBuffer: 1 << 26 }).split('\0').filter(Boolean);
    // Generated or bulk files are named by their folder and the command that makes them: renders, the model, visual
    // baselines, legacy fixtures (copied from the previous application) and recycled files. Omni is not tracked.
    const byFolder = /^(content\/renders\/.+\.avif|content\/models\/showcase\.glb|tests\/e2e\/visual\.spec\.ts-snapshots\/|tests\/fixtures\/legacy\/|_archive\/)/;
    const missing = tracked.filter(path => !byFolder.test(path) && !MPES.includes(`\`${path}\``));
    expect(missing).toEqual([]);
    for (const folder of ['content/renders/', 'content/models/showcase.glb', 'tests/e2e/visual.spec.ts-snapshots/', 'tests/fixtures/legacy/']) {
      expect(MPES, folder).toContain(`\`${folder}`);
    }
  });

  it('names every npm script', () => {
    for (const name of Object.keys(pkg.scripts)) expect(MPES, name).toContain(`\`npm run ${name}\``);
  });

  it('pins every package at its exact version', () => {
    const pins = { ...pkg.dependencies, ...pkg.devDependencies, ...pkg.overrides };
    const lines = MPES.split('\n');
    for (const [name, version] of Object.entries(pins)) {
      expect(lines.some(line => line.includes(`\`${name}\``) && line.includes(version)), `${name} ${version}`).toBe(true);
    }
  });

  it('states the Content-Security-Policy directives the build writes', () => {
    const build = readFileSync('build/render.ts', 'utf8');
    const written = [...build.matchAll(/^\s*[`"]([a-z-]+) /gm)].map(m => m[1]!).sort();
    const section = MPES.split('### 13.1')[1]!.split('\n### ')[0]!;
    const stated = [...section.matchAll(/^\| `([a-z-]+)` \|/gm)].map(m => m[1]!).sort();
    expect(written.length).toBeGreaterThan(10);
    expect(stated).toEqual(written);
  });

  it('plans G3 to G8 with their versions', () => {
    const plan = MPES.split('## 17.')[1]!.split('\n## ')[0]!;
    for (const [goal, version] of [['G3', '0.6.0.0'], ['G4', '0.7.0.0'], ['G5', '0.8.0.0'], ['G6', '0.9.0.0'], ['G7', '0.9.1.0'], ['G8', '1.0.0.0']] as const) {
      expect(plan, goal).toMatch(new RegExp(`\\*\\*${goal}\\b[^|]*\\|[^\\n]*${version.replace(/\./g, '\\.')}`));
    }
  });
});
